214	# Gradient checkpointing (activation recomputation) is enabled for all models
215	# by default — it trades a recompute in backward for a large activation-memory
216	# saving, which matters for the deep/long-context grokking runs. It is applied
217	# per transformer/SSM block and is automatically bypassed in eval (no grad) so
218	# validation/inference cost is unchanged. Override per-run via the "grad_checkpoint"
219	# config key.
220	def _maybe_checkpoint(module, x, enabled):
221	    """Run `module(x)`, optionally under activation checkpointing.
222	
223	    Only checkpoints when training AND grad is being tracked — under
224	    torch.no_grad()/eval there is nothing to recompute so we call directly,
225	    avoiding checkpoint's overhead and its "no input requires grad" warning.
226	    """
227	    if enabled and module.training and torch.is_grad_enabled():
228	        return _grad_checkpoint(module, x, use_reentrant=False)

295	def make_data(p=97, frac_train=0.5, val_ratio=0.10, seed=42):
296	    rng = random.Random(seed)
297	    op_tok, eq_tok = p, p + 1
298	    pairs, labels = [], []
299	    for a in range(p):
300	        for b in range(1, p):
301	            b_inv = pow(b, p - 2, p)
302	            pairs.append([a, op_tok, b, eq_tok])
303	            labels.append((a * b_inv) % p)
304	    c = list(zip(pairs, labels)); rng.shuffle(c)
305	    pairs, labels = zip(*c)
306	    n_train_total = int(len(pairs) * frac_train)
307	    n_val = int(n_train_total * val_ratio)
308	    n_train = n_train_total - n_val
309	    x = torch.tensor(pairs, dtype=torch.long)
310	    y = torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
311	    return x[:n_train], y[:n_train], x[n_train:n_train_total], y[n_train:n_train_total], x[n_train_total:], y[n_train_total:]

314	def make_mnist_addition_data(p=97, frac_train=0.5, val_ratio=0.10, seed=42):
315	    import torchvision
316	    from torchvision import transforms
317	    transform = transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize((14, 14)), transforms.ToTensor()])
318	    mnist = torchvision.datasets.MNIST(root='./data', train=True, download=True, transform=transform)
319	    digit_images = {d: [] for d in range(10)}
320	    for img, label in mnist:
321	        digit_images[label].append(img.squeeze(0))
322	    rng = random.Random(seed)
323	    number_images = {}
324	    for n in range(p):
325	        tens, ones = n // 10, n % 10
326	        img_t = digit_images[tens][rng.randint(0, len(digit_images[tens]) - 1)]
327	        img_o = digit_images[ones][rng.randint(0, len(digit_images[ones]) - 1)]
328	        number_images[n] = torch.cat([img_t, img_o], dim=1)
329	    pairs, labels = [], []
330	    for a in range(p):
331	        for b in range(p):
332	            pairs.append((a, b)); labels.append((a + b) % p)
333	    combined = list(zip(pairs, labels)); rng.shuffle(combined)
334	    pairs, labels = zip(*combined)
335	    n_train_total = int(len(pairs) * frac_train)
336	    n_val = int(n_train_total * val_ratio)
337	    n_train = n_train_total - n_val
338	    images = []
339	    for a, b in pairs:
340	        full = torch.cat([number_images[a], number_images[b]], dim=0)
341	        patches = full.unfold(0, 7, 7).unfold(1, 7, 7).contiguous().reshape(16, 49)
342	        images.append(patches)

347	def make_sequential_division_data(p=97, chain_length=3, frac_train=0.5, val_ratio=0.10, seed=42):
348	    rng = random.Random(seed)
349	    op_tok, eq_tok = p, p + 1
350	    target_size = p * (p - 1)
351	    seen = set(); pairs, labels = [], []
352	    while len(pairs) < target_size:
353	        a = rng.randint(0, p - 1)
354	        bs = tuple(rng.randint(1, p - 1) for _ in range(chain_length))
355	        key = (a, *bs)
356	        if key in seen: continue
357	        seen.add(key)
358	        result = a
359	        for b in bs: result = (result * pow(b, p - 2, p)) % p
360	        seq = [a]
361	        for b in bs: seq.extend([op_tok, b])
362	        seq.append(eq_tok)
363	        pairs.append(seq); labels.append(result)
364	    combined = list(zip(pairs, labels)); rng.shuffle(combined)
365	    pairs, labels = zip(*combined)
366	    n_train_total = int(len(pairs) * frac_train)
367	    n_val = int(n_train_total * val_ratio)
368	    n_train = n_train_total - n_val
369	    x = torch.tensor(pairs, dtype=torch.long); y = torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
370	    return x[:n_train], y[:n_train], x[n_train:n_train_total], y[n_train:n_train_total], x[n_train_total:], y[n_train_total:]

381	class DecoderBlock(nn.Module):
382	    def __init__(self, d, h, seq_len=4):
383	        super().__init__()
384	        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, h, dropout=0., batch_first=True)
385	        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
386	        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4*d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4*d, d))
387	        self.register_buffer('causal_mask', torch.triu(torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len, dtype=torch.bool), 1))
388	    def forward(self, x):
389	        a, _ = self.attn(x, x, x, attn_mask=self.causal_mask)
390	        x = self.n1(x + a); return self.n2(x + self.ff(x))

542	class EarlyStopper:
543	    def __init__(self, threshold=0.95, max_steps=20_000, patience=500, metric_name="test_acc"):
544	        self.threshold=threshold; self.max_steps=max_steps; self.patience=patience
545	        self.metric_name=metric_name  # which accuracy feeds step(): "test_acc" or "val_acc"
546	        # [A4-M1/M2] best_metric_acc / metric_acc are metric-agnostic names: under
547	        # val-stopping this tracks val, under test-stopping it tracks test — the
548	        # old test_acc-specific names mislabelled the val-criterion runs.
549	        self._triggered=False; self._counter=0; self.best_metric_acc=0.
550	        self.grokking_step=None; self.grokking_wall=None; self._t0=time.time()
551	        self.stopping_reason=None; self.stopping_step=None
552	    def step(self, metric_acc, current_step):
553	        if current_step >= self.max_steps:
554	            if self.stopping_reason is None:
555	                self.stopping_reason="max_steps"; self.stopping_step=current_step
556	            return True
557	        self.best_metric_acc = max(self.best_metric_acc, metric_acc)
558	        if metric_acc >= self.threshold:
559	            if not self._triggered:
560	                if torch.cuda.is_available(): torch.cuda.synchronize()
561	                self._triggered=True; self.grokking_step=current_step
562	                self.grokking_wall = time.time()-self._t0
563	            self._counter += 1
564	            if self._counter >= self.patience:
565	                if self.stopping_reason is None:
566	                    self.stopping_reason=f"{self.metric_name}_threshold"; self.stopping_step=current_step
567	                return True
568	        else: self._counter=0
569	        return False

663	def _autocast(c):
664	    """Forward/backward autocast per the matmul_precision axis.
665	
666	    Precedence: legacy use_amp=True keeps the old fp16+GradScaler behavior;
667	    otherwise matmul_precision selects bf16 autocast (default) or none

677	        # other ops ride the standard bf16 carrier, as in TE-style recipes.
678	        return torch.amp.autocast('cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16)

696	def _progressive_eval_freq(step, base_freq=10, max_freq=50, scale=0.01, thresh=500):
697	    """Sigmoid-driven eval frequency: eval less often early, more often later."""
698	    heat = 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-scale * (step - thresh)))

700	    return max(base_freq, round(freq))

718	def _eval_log(r, step, m, tx, ty, vax, vay, tex, tey, c, st, pb):
719	    # Fused single-sync evaluation. The naive 3× evaluate() did SIX GPU→CPU
720	    # .item() round-trips per eval AND built autograd graphs for ~9.3K samples
721	    # (evaluate() lacked no_grad) — at the tuner's every-step cadence across a
722	    # 28-worker MPS fleet those sync stalls dominated (GPU ~25-40% util).
723	    # Identical math: same ops/dtypes, all metrics computed on-device, ONE
724	    # device→host transfer.
725	    p_ = c["p"]
726	    if c.get("fast_val_eval") and step % 10 != 0:
727	        # Between full evals: VAL-ONLY check (465 samples vs ~9.3K for the
728	        # triple) feeding just the early-stopper — preserves every-step
729	        # grokking_step resolution at ~1/9 the eval cost. Records/callbacks
730	        # stay on the 10-step grid.
731	        with torch.no_grad():
732	            logits = m(vax)
733	            va_t = torch.stack([F.cross_entropy(logits, vay),
734	                                (logits[:, :p_].argmax(-1) == vay).float().mean()])
735	            vl_f, va_f = va_t.cpu().tolist()
736	        stop_acc = va_f if c.get("early_stop_on", "test") == "val" else None
737	        if stop_acc is None:
738	            return False, None, None  # fast path only valid with val stopping
739	        return st.step(stop_acc, step), None, None
740	    with torch.no_grad():
741	        outs = []
742	        for x_, y_ in ((tx, ty), (vax, vay), (tex, tey)):
743	            logits = m(x_)
744	            outs.append(torch.stack([
745	                F.cross_entropy(logits, y_),
746	                (logits[:, :p_].argmax(-1) == y_).float().mean()]))
747	        (tl, ta), (vl, va), (tel, tea) = torch.stack(outs).cpu().tolist()
748	    r.steps.append(step); r.train_losses.append(tl); r.train_accs.append(ta)
749	    r.val_losses.append(vl); r.val_accs.append(va)
750	    r.test_losses.append(tel); r.test_accs.append(tea)
751	    pb.set_postfix({"trn":f"{ta:.3f}","val":f"{va:.3f}","tst":f"{tea:.3f}","tl":f"{tl:.3f}"}, refresh=False)
752	    # Optional per-eval observer (e.g. the Optuna tuner's pruning hook). May
753	    # raise (optuna.TrialPruned) to abort the run; absent in the race itself.
754	    cb = c.get("_eval_callback")
755	    if cb is not None:
756	        cb(step, ta, va, tea)
757	    stop_acc = va if c.get("early_stop_on", "test") == "val" else tea
758	    return st.step(stop_acc, step), tl, tel

771	def _record_train_path(r):
772	    """Stamp r.train_path from the L3-TC engine that ACTUALLY ran this step.
773	
774	    Reads the module global LAST_L3_ENGINE (set by _try_fused_train_step on a
775	    successful L3-TC step → carries the ACTUAL engine). Composes the human label
776	    ("L3-TC bf16").
777	
778	    PURE L3-TC (owner directive: NO silent downgrade, ever). The eager / L1-tail /
779	    scalar paths were REMOVED, so the ONLY way a train_* loop reaches here is via a
780	    successful L3-TC step (LAST_L3_ENGINE set). If an L3-CAPABLE cell somehow
781	    reached completion WITHOUT firing L3-TC, that is a silent-gate regression —
782	    HARD RAISE (the old code soft-degraded to a DEGRADED/ABI-stale label; that
783	    fallback is gone). A genuinely non-L3 cell can never get here: it raises inside
784	    _try_fused_train_step before training completes.
785	    """
786	    if LAST_L3_ENGINE is not None:
787	        r.train_path = LAST_L3_ENGINE["path"]
788	        return
789	    # No engine recorded: an L3-capable cell finished a run without firing L3-TC.
790	    # There is no eager/L1/scalar path to attribute it to — this is a wiring
791	    # regression, not a degrade. HARD-FAIL (no silent downgrade).
792	    opt_key = OPT_KEY_BY_NAME.get(r.name)
793	    l3_capable = opt_key is not None and has_l3_real(r.model_type, opt_key)
794	    raise RuntimeError(
795	        f"L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: {r.name}/"
796	        f"{r.model_type} @ {r.matmul_precision} completed without firing the "
797	        f"L3-TC megakernel (LAST_L3_ENGINE is None; l3_capable={l3_capable}, "
798	        f"use_fused_requested={r.use_fused_requested}, use_amp={r.use_amp}). "
799	        f"The eager/L1/scalar fallback paths were removed — this is a wiring "
800	        f"regression, investigate the gate (has_l3_real / gemm_impl_for_cell).")

804	    if torch.cuda.is_available(): torch.cuda.synchronize()

808	    r.stopping_reason=st.stopping_reason; r.stopping_step=st.stopping_step
809	    r.best_metric_acc=st.best_metric_acc  # [A4-M2] best stopper-criterion acc
810	    r.final_train_acc = r.train_accs[-1] if r.train_accs else 0.
811	    r.final_val_acc = r.val_accs[-1] if r.val_accs else 0.
812	    r.final_val_loss = r.val_losses[-1] if r.val_losses else 0.

830	        r.grokking_step_test_confirmed = False

900	def _try_fused_train_step(model_name, opt_name, model, optimizer, x_batch,
901	                          y_batch, c):
902	    """Run the TRUE L3-TC fused TRAIN step (real fwd+bwd+opt in ONE persistent
903	    wgmma megakernel) for an L3-REAL cell. Model-GENERIC: fires for whichever of
904	    (transformer_decoder|vit|mamba × <wgmma-wired optimizer>) is registered on this
905	    arch (has_l3_real gates it). x_batch is the per-model input the cell expects —
906	    int token ids [B,seq] for decoder/mamba, float patches [B,16,49] for vit — and
907	    flows unchanged into fused_train_step, which packs it per model (see
908	    dispatch.py).
909	
910	    This REPLACES the eager forward + backward + optimizer.step() entirely: ONE
911	    persistent wgmma kernel runs the real model forward+backward AND the optimizer
912	    update — real model math, real optimizer math, ZERO intermediate launches.
913	
914	    PURE L3-TC (owner directive: NO silent downgrade, ever — hard-fail otherwise).
915	    There is NO eager fallback left. ALWAYS returns the training LOSS (a float,
916	    mean cross-entropy) on success; on ANY condition that the old code would have
917	    declined to eager for (fusion off, not an L3-REAL cell, AMP on, unwired
918	    precision, stale ABI) it RAISES RuntimeError rather than silently downgrading.
919	    On success it sets the module-global LAST_L3_ENGINE to the engine that ACTUALLY
920	    ran (dispatch.cpp has no silent fallback: a wgmma request runs wgmma or throws),
921	    so the path report is the real executed path, not the requested one.
922	    """
923	    global LAST_L3_ENGINE
924	    LAST_L3_ENGINE = None  # default: set on success below (a failure RAISES, never returns)
925	    if not c.get("use_fused", True):
926	        raise RuntimeError(
927	            "L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: fusion is "
928	            "disabled (use_fused=False), but the eager path was removed")
929	    if not has_l3_real(model_name, opt_name):
930	        raise RuntimeError(
931	            f"L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: ({model_name}, "
932	            f"{opt_name}) is not an L3-REAL cell on this arch (has_l3_real=False)")
933	    # PURE L3-TC: the wgmma tensor-core megakernel is the ONLY engine. AMP has no
934	    # in-kernel carrier (the megakernel reads raw fp32 params), so it is a hard
935	    # failure, not an eager fallback.
936	    if c.get("use_amp", False):
937	        raise RuntimeError(
938	            "L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: AMP is enabled "
939	            "(use_amp=True), but the L3-TC megakernel reads raw fp32 params and "
940	            "there is no eager/AMP fallback. Disable AMP for the L3-TC path")
941	    precision = _resolve_matmul_precision(c)
942	    gemm_impl = gemm_impl_for_cell(model_name, opt_name, precision)
943	    if gemm_impl is None:
944	        raise RuntimeError(
945	            f"L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: no wgmma engine "
946	            f"for ({model_name}, {opt_name}) at precision {precision!r} "
947	            f"(gemm_impl_for_cell returned None) and there is no scalar/eager "
948	            f"fallback")
949	    announce_fused_readiness()  # one-time loud run-start banner (idempotent)
950	    # Persistent flat-param + [m|v|extra]+loss state on the optimizer instance
951	    # (keyed by canonical model name), surviving across iterations — the megakernel
952	    # owns optimizer.step(), so the torch optimizer's .state never fills;
953	    # reallocating per step would reset momentum and never grok.
954	    cache = getattr(optimizer, "_fused_train_cache", None)
955	    if cache is None:
956	        cache = {}
957	        optimizer._fused_train_cache = cache
958	    step = getattr(optimizer, "_fused_train_counter", 0) + 1
959	    optimizer._fused_train_counter = step
960	    try:
961	        loss = fused_train_step(model_name, opt_name, model, optimizer,
962	                                x_batch, y_batch, state_cache=cache, step=step,
963	                                gemm_impl=gemm_impl)
964	    except TypeError as e:
965	        # A pybind TypeError means the compiled _ops extension predates the widened
966	        # fused_step signature (rebuild pending). PURE L3-TC: this is NOT a soft-
967	        # degrade — there is no eager path to fall back to. HARD-FAIL.
968	        raise RuntimeError(
969	            "L3-TC unavailable; refusing to silently downgrade: stale-ABI "
970	            f"(compiled _ops predates the widened fused_step signature — rebuild "
971	            f"the extension): {e}") from e
972	    # Success → record the ACTUAL executed engine for the wiring guard / roofline.
973	    LAST_L3_ENGINE = dict(
974	        engine=gemm_impl, model=canonicalize_model(model_name),
975	        precision=precision, path=_l3_path_label(gemm_impl, precision))
976	    return loss

1564	def _ema_smooth(values, alpha=0.9):
1565	    """Exponential moving average smoothing."""
1566	    if not values: return values
1567	    smoothed = [values[0]]
1568	    for v in values[1:]:
1569	        smoothed.append(alpha * smoothed[-1] + (1 - alpha) * v)
1570	    return smoothed

1572	def _is_crashed(r):

1574	    CRASHED: stopping_reason — distinguish it from a genuine DNF (which has a
1575	    full curve but never grokked)."""
1576	    return (not r.steps) and isinstance(r.stopping_reason, str) and r.stopping_reason.startswith("CRASHED:")

1578	def _live(runs):
1579	    """[A4-H3] Drop crash stubs (steps==[] / CRASHED reason) from a runs list so
1580	    curve/bar aggregations operate only on runs that actually produced data;
1581	    crashes are counted separately (save_json _meta.crashes, print_summary)."""
1582	    return [r for r in runs if not _is_crashed(r)]

1584	def _grok_rate(runs):
1585	    """[A4-H3] Grok success rate over LIVE runs (crash stubs excluded from both
1586	    numerator and denominator); np.nan when every seed crashed so the heatmap
1587	    renders it as 0 via nan_to_num rather than dividing by zero."""
1588	    lv=_live(runs)
1589	    if not lv: return float("nan")
1590	    return sum(1 for r in lv if r.grokking_step)/len(lv)

1592	def _interpolate_runs(runs, attr, num_points=500):
1593	    """Interpolate multiple runs onto a common step grid, return mean ± std."""
1594	    runs = _live(runs)  # [A4-H3] skip crashed runs (empty curves)
1595	    if not runs: return [], [], []
1596	    steps_avail = [r.steps[-1] for r in runs if r.steps]
1597	    if not steps_avail: return [], [], []
1598	    max_step = max(steps_avail)
1599	    if max_step == 0: return [], [], []
1600	    common_steps = np.linspace(0, max_step, num_points)
1601	    interpolated = []
1602	    for r in runs:
1603	        if not r.steps: continue
1604	        vals = np.array(getattr(r, attr))
1605	        steps = np.array(r.steps)
1606	        interp = np.interp(common_steps, steps, vals)
1607	        interpolated.append(interp)
1608	    if not interpolated: return [], [], []
1609	    arr = np.array(interpolated)
1610	    return common_steps, arr.mean(axis=0), arr.std(axis=0)

Dispatch by `c["model_type"]`:
- `decoder` → `make_data` (295): `(a÷b) mod 97`, 4-token seq `[a, op_tok=p, b, eq_tok=p+1]`, label `(a*b_inv)%p` via Fermat inverse. Shuffle seeded.
- `vit` → `make_mnist_addition_data` (314): MNIST resized 14×14, two digits cat'd into 28-wide number image, two numbers stacked → unfold into 16 patches of 49. label `(a+b)%p`.
- `mamba` → `make_sequential_division_data` (347): chained division `(a÷b1÷b2÷b3) mod 97`, seq `[a, op, b1, op, b2, op, b3, eq]`, target_size=p*(p-1), dedup via `seen`.
All three split: `n_train_total=len*frac_train`, `n_val=n_train_total*val_ratio`, `n_train=total-val`; return 6-tuple (train x/y, val x/y, test x/y).

## evaluate (535-540)
`@torch.no_grad()`. `logits=model(x)`; loss=CE; `acc=(logits[:,:p].argmax(-1)==y).mean()`. Note the `[:,:p]` slice — clips the 99-token vocab to the p=97 class range for argmax (op/eq tokens never valid labels).

## EarlyStopper (542-569)
- ctor: threshold=0.95, max_steps=20000, patience=500(default; race overrides to 50), metric_name ("test_acc"|"val_acc").
- `step(metric_acc, current_step)`: returns True (stop) if `current_step>=max_steps` (sets reason="max_steps"). Tracks `best_metric_acc`. On `metric_acc>=threshold`: first crossing records `grokking_step`/`grokking_wall` (cuda.synchronize), then counts up `_counter`; at `_counter>=patience` sets reason=`{metric_name}_threshold` and stops. Below threshold resets `_counter=0`.
- KEY DEFAULT_CONFIG comment (283-287, A4-H1): patience counts EVALS not steps: 50 evals × eval_every=10 = 500-step post-grok hold. Old 500×100=50k EXCEEDED max_steps so the threshold-stop was unreachable; every cell burned full budget.

Sigmoid-driven eval cadence: `heat=1/(1+exp(-scale*(step-thresh)))`; `freq=max_freq-(max_freq-base_freq)*heat`; returns `max(base_freq, round(freq))`. base=10,max=50,scale=0.01,thresh=500. 390	# Preflight: nvcc major == torch.version.cuda major.
391	#
392	# torch's BuildExtension links the new .so against the PyTorch CUDA runtime
393	# (torch.version.cuda). If the nvcc on PATH is a DIFFERENT major version, two
394	# silent failures result: (a) a newer GPU arch (e.g. Blackwell sm_100, which
395	# needs nvcc 12.8+) is dropped from the fatbin even though torch supports it,
396	# and (b) device/host code is compiled against a CUDA major that mismatches
397	# the runtime torch loads, an ABI hazard. We surface this loudly. Set
398	# NVCC_CUDA_MAJOR_OK=1 to downgrade the raise to a warning (deliberate
399	# cross-major builds, e.g. CI matrices).
400	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
401	def _nvcc_major():
402	    exe = shutil.which("nvcc")
403	    if not exe:
404	        return None
405	    try:
406	        out = subprocess.run([exe, "--version"], capture_output=True,
407	                             text=True, timeout=30).stdout
408	        m = re.search(r"release (\d+)\.", out)
409	        return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
410	    except Exception:
411	        return None

421	    if nvcc_maj is None:
422	        return  # no nvcc on PATH (e.g. torch ships its own); nothing to check.
423	    try:
424	        torch_maj = int(torch_cuda.split(".")[0])
425	    except (ValueError, IndexError):
426	        return
427	    if nvcc_maj != torch_maj:

429	            f"CUDA major mismatch: nvcc is CUDA {nvcc_maj}.x but "
430	            f"torch.version.cuda is {torch_cuda} (major {torch_maj}). "
431	            "The extension would be compiled against a different CUDA major "
432	            "than the PyTorch runtime it loads into — newer arches (e.g. "
433	            "Blackwell sm_100, nvcc 12.8+) may be silently dropped and the "
434	            "ABI may mismatch. Align nvcc with PyTorch's CUDA toolkit, or set "
435	            "NVCC_CUDA_MAJOR_OK=1 to proceed anyway."

459	    # retained as a no-op safety net in case a stray overlay file is
460	    # checked in by accident. *_selftest.cu TUs (e.g. wgmma_selftest.cu)
461	    # define their OWN pybind module and are JIT-loaded by their tests —
462	    # linking them into _ops would collide on PyInit__ops (multiple
463	    # definition; observed at the wgmma substrate landing).
464	    #
465	    # The same collision is produced by any standalone-JIT cell driver that
466	    # owns a PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, …) and is loaded directly
467	    # via torch.utils.cpp_extension.load (e.g. csrc/fused/sm_90/
468	    # mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu — the R2.3 Fork-B TC cell, JIT-loaded by

472	    # PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME …): inside _ops that macro re-emits
473	    # PyInit__ops and (via its #included megakernel header) the decoder dec_*

476	    # regardless of naming. (.cu only — the standalone-JIT pattern is CUDA;
477	    # HIP cell TUs use the SG_GFX942_DEVICE_TU guard, not their own module.)

479	        if not path.endswith(".cu"):

483	                return "PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME" in fh.read()

916	def _scan_csrc_ifndef_macros():
917	    """Collect every ``SG_TUNED_*`` macro guarded by an ``#ifndef`` in the
918	    committed device tree (csrc/). Returns the set of guarded macro names.
919	
920	    Programmatic scan (no single hard-coded header): the eager per-op headers
921	    that used to carry the guards (grokking_optimizers/kernels/sm_90/*_sm90.cuh)
922	    were deleted in the L3-TC-only cut, so a single-file check
923	    silently early-returns and the drift guard never fires. Walking csrc/ for
924	    ``#ifndef SG_TUNED_<NAME>`` tracks the real guard set wherever it lives
925	    (megakernel_common.cuh, the *_tc.cuh substrates, tile_pipeline.cuh, ...).
926	    """
927	    pat = re.compile(r"#ifndef\s+(SG_TUNED_[A-Z0-9_]+)")
928	    exts = (".cu", ".cuh", ".h", ".hpp", ".hip", ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx")
929	    found = set()
930	    csrc_root = os.path.join(_REPO_ROOT, "csrc")
931	    for dirpath, _dirs, files in os.walk(csrc_root):
932	        for fn in files:
933	            if not fn.endswith(exts):
934	                continue
935	            try:
936	                with open(os.path.join(dirpath, fn), "r",
937	                          errors="ignore") as fh:
938	                    found.update(pat.findall(fh.read()))
939	            except OSError:
940	                continue
941	    return found

944	def _verify_macro_names(inject):
945	    """Best-effort drift check: every macro name the injector is about to emit
946	    is guarded by an ``#ifndef SG_TUNED_*`` in some committed kernel. Loud
947	    warning on mismatch; never fatal (design 1c).
948	
949	    Replaces the prior single-file check against the (now-deleted)
950	    kernels/sm_90/adamw_sm90.cuh — that path no longer exists, so the old guard
951	    early-returned and could never catch the case it was meant to (an injected
952	    macro that no kernel reads, i.e. a dead ``-D``). A programmatic scan of
953	    csrc/ for the ``#ifndef`` guards is robust to where the guards live.
954	    """
955	    try:
956	        guarded = _scan_csrc_ifndef_macros()
957	        if not guarded:
958	            # No csrc/ visible (e.g. an installed wheel without sources) —
959	            # nothing to compare against; skip silently.
960	            return
961	        missing = sorted(name for name in inject.header_default_macros()
962	                         if name not in guarded)
963	        if missing:
964	            print("  [tuned-inject] WARNING: macro name(s) in the injector "
965	                  "source-of-truth (_tuned_inject.MACROS) are NOT guarded by "
966	                  f"any '#ifndef SG_TUNED_*' in csrc/: {missing}. Emitting them "
967	                  "anyway, but they may be silent no-ops — reconcile "
968	                  "_tuned_inject.MACROS with the committed kernels.")
969	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — diagnostic only.
970	        pass

151	    global _G
152	    if _G is None:
153	        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
154	        import grokking_race_v2 as g
155	        _G = g
156	    return _G
157	
158	
159	_CACHE = {}
160	
161	
162	def _cfg(opt, model, steps):
163	    """A minimal race config that runs `steps` pure train steps (no eval, no early
164	    stop) at the production precision (bf16 → the wgmma engine for TC cells)."""
165	    g = _g()
166	    c = dict(g.DEFAULT_CONFIG)
167	    c.update(g.OPTIMIZER_CONFIGS[opt])
168	    c.update({"seed": 42, "model_type": model, "frac_train": 0.5, "val_ratio": 0.10,
169	              "p": 97, "use_amp": False, "use_fused": True, "compile_model": False,
170	              "matmul_precision": "bf16",  # production default → wgmma for TC cells
171	              "max_steps": steps, "early_stop_max_steps": steps,
172	              "eval_every": 10 ** 9, "early_stop_threshold": 1.01,
173	              "early_stop_patience": 10 ** 9, "weight_decay": 1.0})
174	    return c
175	
176	
177	def _data_init(model):
178	    import torch
179	    if model not in _CACHE:
180	        g = _g()
181	        c = _cfg("adamw", model, 10)
182	        dev = torch.device("cuda")
183	        data = tuple(d.to(dev) for d in g.make_data_for_task(c, 42))
184	        m0 = g.build_model(c, dev)
185	        init = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in m0.state_dict().items()}
186	        del m0
187	        _CACHE[model] = (data, init)
188	    return _CACHE[model]
189	
190	
191	def check_cell(opt, model, steps=4):
192	    """Route ONE cell through the real race train fn for `steps` steps and report
193	    the OBSERVED execution path. Returns a dict row (never raises for a cell-level
194	    failure — it records it so the table is complete)."""
195	    import torch
196	    g = _g()
197	    fn = g.OPTIMIZER_REGISTRY[opt]
198	    data, init = _data_init(model)
199	    dev = torch.device("cuda")
200	
201	    # Capture the engine of EVERY L3 step + whether L1 ever fired, by wrapping the
202	    # two dispatch entry points (identical technique to tuning.roofline). We record
203	    # the SET of engines seen across the timed steps so a cell that flickers between
204	    # paths is caught (it must be wgmma on EVERY step to pass).
205	    seen_l3_engines = []
206	    l1_fired = [0]
207	    _orig_l3 = g._try_fused_train_step
208	    _orig_l1 = g._try_fused_step
209	
210	    def _wrap_l3(*a, **k):
211	        r = _orig_l3(*a, **k)
212	        if r is not None:
213	            eng = g.LAST_L3_ENGINE["engine"] if g.LAST_L3_ENGINE else None
214	            seen_l3_engines.append(eng)
215	        return r
216	
217	    def _wrap_l1(*a, **k):
218	        r = _orig_l1(*a, **k)
219	        if r:
220	            l1_fired[0] += 1
221	        return r
222	
223	    g._try_fused_train_step = _wrap_l3
224	    g._try_fused_step = _wrap_l1
225	    err = None
226	    try:
227	        c = _cfg(opt, model, steps)
228	        torch.manual_seed(42)
229	        fn(c, init, *data, dev, bp=0)
230	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
231	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — record the failure into the row
232	        err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
233	        traceback.print_exc()
234	    finally:
235	        g._try_fused_train_step = _orig_l3
236	        g._try_fused_step = _orig_l1
237	
238	    abi_stale = bool(getattr(g, "_FUSED_ABI_STALE", False))
239	    n_l3 = len(seen_l3_engines)
240	    all_wgmma = (n_l3 > 0 and all(e == "wgmma" for e in seen_l3_engines)
241	                 and not abi_stale and err is None)
242	    # Observed path label (mirrors roofline's actual_path semantics).
243	    if err is not None:
244	        path = f"ERROR ({err.split(':')[0]})"
245	    elif abi_stale:
246	        path = "eager(ABI-stale)"
247	    elif n_l3 > 0 and all(e == "wgmma" for e in seen_l3_engines):
248	        path = "L3-TC-megakernel(wgmma)"
249	    elif n_l3 > 0 and all(e == "scalar" for e in seen_l3_engines):
250	        path = "L3-scalar-megakernel"
251	    elif n_l3 > 0:
252	        path = "L3-mixed(" + ",".join(sorted(set(seen_l3_engines))) + ")"
253	    elif l1_fired[0] > 0:
254	        path = "eager+L1-fused-tail"
255	    else:
256	        path = "eager"
257	
258	    converted = bool(all_wgmma)
259	    if converted:
260	        reason = ""
261	    elif err is not None:
262	        reason = f"step raised: {err}"
263	    elif abi_stale:
264	        reason = ("ABI-stale latch tripped (extension predates the widened "
265	                  "fused_step signature) — rebuild _ops then re-run.")
266	    elif path == "L3-scalar-megakernel":
267	        reason = ("ran the fp32 SCALAR L3 megakernel, not the bf16 wgmma TC engine. "
268	                  + _MODEL_NOTE.get(model, ""))
269	    else:
270	        # eager / eager+L1: the cell has no production L3-TC route.
271	        # Single-launch wgmma-tail optimizers (lion is the only converted one; the
272	        # others have their own tail-specific blocker) that land on mamba are blocked
273	        # by the MISSING mamba wgmma launcher TU — cite that, not the generic reason.
274	        _wgmma_tails = {"adamw", "lion", "grokfast", "grokadamw", "neuralgrok"}
275	        if model == "mamba" and opt in _wgmma_tails and opt not in _BLOCK_REASONS:
276	            reason = ("BLOCKED by the missing mamba wgmma launcher TU. " + _MODEL_NOTE["mamba"])
277	        elif model == "mamba" and opt in ("prodigy", "looksam"):
278	            # NOTE: prodigy/mamba + looksam/mamba are now CONVERTED (the A/A/A race — a
279	            # register-pressure wgmma-accumulator spill in the mamba TC backward — is FIXED via
280	            # the fused dB/dC reduce + a_save-drop + __noinline__ in model_stage_mamba{3,_tc}.cuh;
281	            # they PASS test_l3tc_tail_gate A/A/A bit-exact). They route engine=="wgmma" and hit
282	            # the `if converted` branch above, so this branch is normally DEAD for them; it only
283	            # fires if a build regresses the route. Kept as a tripwire.
284	            reason = ("UNEXPECTED: mamba×" + opt + " did NOT route wgmma despite the A/A/A race "
285	                      "fix — check the dispatch.cpp mamba gate + the __noinline__ scan-bwd fix.")
286	        else:
287	            reason = _BLOCK_REASONS.get(
288	                opt, "no production L3-TC route wired for this (model, optimizer).")
289	        if model in _MODEL_NOTE and opt == "adamw":
290	            reason = _MODEL_NOTE[model]
291	
292	    return {
293	        "model": model, "optimizer": opt,
294	        "executed_path": path,
295	        "l3_steps_fired": n_l3,
296	        "l3_engines_seen": sorted(set(seen_l3_engines)),
297	        "l1_steps_fired": l1_fired[0],
298	        "abi_stale": abi_stale,
299	        "error": err,
300	        "is_l3_tc": converted,
301	        "reason_if_blocked": reason,
302	    }
303	
304	
305	def main():
306	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
307	    ap.add_argument("--models", default=",".join(MODELS))
308	    ap.add_argument("--opts", default=",".join(OPTS))
309	    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=4,
310	                    help="real train steps to route per cell (default 4)")
311	    ap.add_argument("--require-all", action="store_true",
312	                    help="exit 1 unless EVERY routed cell executed L3-TC (the "
313	                         "full-baseline gate); default exits 0 with the split")
314	    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(OUT / "wiring_check.json"))
315	    args = ap.parse_args()
316	    models = [m for m in args.models.split(",") if m]
317	    opts = [o for o in args.opts.split(",") if o]
318	    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
319	
320	    print(f"[wiring_check] routing {len(models)*len(opts)} cells "
321	          f"({len(models)} models x {len(opts)} opts), {args.steps} real steps each.\n"
322	          f"[wiring_check] PASS == executed engine is wgmma (bf16 TC L3 megakernel) "
323	          f"on EVERY step.\n", flush=True)
324	    rows = []
325	    for model in models:
326	        for opt in opts:
327	            row = check_cell(opt, model, steps=args.steps)
328	            rows.append(row)
329	            mark = "PASS L3-TC" if row["is_l3_tc"] else "BLOCKED   "
330	            extra = "" if row["is_l3_tc"] else f"  ← {row['reason_if_blocked'][:72]}"
331	            print(f"  [{mark}] {opt:11s}/{model:7s}  path={row['executed_path']:26s}"
332	                  f"{extra}", flush=True)
333	
334	    converted = [r for r in rows if r["is_l3_tc"]]
335	    blocked = [r for r in rows if not r["is_l3_tc"]]
336	    n = len(rows)
337	    frac = len(converted) / n if n else 0.0
338	    summary = {
339	        "total_cells": n,
340	        "converted_l3_tc": len(converted),
341	        "blocked": len(blocked),
342	        "fraction_l3_tc": round(frac, 4),
343	        "converted_cells": [f"{r['optimizer']}/{r['model']}" for r in converted],
344	        "blocked_cells": [f"{r['optimizer']}/{r['model']}" for r in blocked],
345	    }
346	    payload = {"summary": summary, "rows": rows}
347	    Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
348	    print(f"\n[wiring_check] {len(converted)}/{n} cells on L3-TC "
349	          f"({100*frac:.1f}%).  wrote {args.out}", flush=True)
350	
351	    # Fraction table by model (the directive's "frac table" seed).
352	    print("\n[wiring_check] L3-TC fraction by model:", flush=True)
353	    for model in models:
354	        mrows = [r for r in rows if r["model"] == model]
355	        c = sum(1 for r in mrows if r["is_l3_tc"])
356	        print(f"   {model:8s}: {c}/{len(mrows)} L3-TC", flush=True)
357	
358	    if args.require_all and blocked:
359	        print(f"\n[wiring_check] FAIL-LOUD (--require-all): {len(blocked)} cell(s) "
360	              f"are NOT L3-TC. The locked baseline requires all 33 on L3-TC. "
361	              f"Blocked: {summary['blocked_cells']}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
362	        sys.exit(1)
363	    print("\n[wiring_check] DONE", flush=True)
364	
365	
366	if __name__ == "__main__":
367	    main()

299	            jax.profiler.start_trace(tdir)
300	            try:
301	                exec(compile({script!r}, '<smoke>', 'exec'))
302	            except Exception:
303	                traceback.print_exc()
304	            finally:
305	                jax.profiler.stop_trace()
306	            print('--- trace dir contents ---')
307	            for root, _, files in os.walk(tdir):
308	                for f in files:
309	                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
310	                    size = os.path.getsize(fp)
311	                    print(f'{{f}}: {{size}} bytes')
312	    """).strip()
313	    run_capture([sys.executable, "-c", wrapper], report)
314	
315	
316	def opt_for_launcher(path: Path) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
317	    """Map csrc/.../launch_<NAME>(.cu|.hip.cpp|.hip|.py) → optimizer tuple."""
318	    stem = path.stem
319	    if stem.endswith(".hip"):
320	        stem = stem[: -len(".hip")]
321	    stem = stem.replace("launch_", "")
322	    for tup in OPTIMIZERS:
323	        if tup[0] == stem:
324	            return tup
325	    for tup in OPTIMIZERS:
326	        if stem.startswith(tup[0] + "_") or stem.startswith(tup[0]):
327	            return tup
328	    return None
329	
330	
331	# ===========================================================================
332	#  Real latency/throughput measurement (the timing half — runs on CPU now,
333	#  uses CUDA events when a GPU is present). Times the fused optimizer step
334	#  against an ATen-baseline reference path on realistic parameter shapes.
335	# ===========================================================================
336	
337	# Realistic per-step workloads: (label, [tensor shapes]) — a transformer-ish
338	# mix of 2D weight matrices + 1D bias/norm vectors, several sizes. NOT 64x64.
339	BENCH_WORKLOADS: List[Tuple[str, List[Tuple[int, ...]]]] = [
340	    ("tiny",   [(256, 256), (256,)]),
341	    ("small",  [(1024, 1024), (1024,), (4096, 1024), (4096,)]),
342	    ("medium", [(4096, 4096), (4096,), (4096, 11008), (11008,)]),
343	    ("wide",   [(8192, 2048), (2048, 8192), (8192,), (2048,)]),
344	]
345	
346	
347	def _percentile(samples: List[float], pct: float) -> float:
348	    """Nearest-rank percentile (pct in [0, 100]) over a list of latencies."""
349	    if not samples:
350	        return float("nan")
351	    s = sorted(samples)
352	    k = max(0, min(len(s) - 1, int(round((pct / 100.0) * (len(s) - 1)))))
353	    return s[k]
354	
355	
356	def _time_callable(fn: Callable[[], None], *, warmup: int, iters: int,
357	                   cuda: bool) -> List[float]:
358	    """Return a list of `iters` per-call latencies in milliseconds.
359	
360	    Warms up `warmup` times first. On CUDA uses torch.cuda.Event timing (so the
361	    async launch queue is measured correctly); on CPU uses time.perf_counter.
362	    """
363	    import torch
364	
365	    for _ in range(warmup):
366	        fn()
367	    if cuda:
368	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
369	
370	    samples: List[float] = []
371	    if cuda:
372	        for _ in range(iters):
373	            start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
374	            end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
375	            start.record()
376	            fn()
377	            end.record()
378	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
379	            samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end))   # ms
380	    else:
381	        for _ in range(iters):
382	            t0 = time.perf_counter()
383	            fn()
384	            samples.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3)   # ms
385	    return samples
386	
387	
388	def _make_params(shapes: List[Tuple[int, ...]], device: str, dtype) -> list:
389	    import torch
390	
391	    params = []
392	    for shape in shapes:
393	        p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.randn(*shape, device=device, dtype=dtype))
394	        p.grad = torch.randn_like(p)
395	        params.append(p)
396	    return params
397	
398	
399	def _refresh_grads(params: list) -> None:
400	    import torch
401	
402	    for p in params:
403	        p.grad = torch.randn_like(p)
404	
405	
406	# ATen baseline: stock torch.optim equivalents for the kernels we can compare
407	# against 1:1. The fused path is the project's optimizer; the baseline is the
408	# vanilla ATen implementation of the same math.
409	ATEN_BASELINE: Dict[str, Callable] = {}
410	
411	
412	def _init_aten_baselines() -> None:
413	    import torch
414	
415	    ATEN_BASELINE["adamw"] = lambda params: torch.optim.AdamW(
416	        params, lr=1e-3, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=1e-2)
417	    # Lion landed in torch.optim in newer releases; fall back to None if absent.
418	    if hasattr(torch.optim, "Lion"):
419	        ATEN_BASELINE["lion"] = lambda params: torch.optim.Lion(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
420	            params, lr=1e-4, betas=(0.9, 0.99), weight_decay=0.0)
421	
422	
423	def _build_fused_optimizer(opt_class: str, params: list):
424	    """Construct the project's fused optimizer; returns None (and the reason)
425	    if the extension isn't built / the class can't run on this device."""
426	    try:
427	        import grokking_optimizers as go
428	        cls = getattr(go, opt_class)
429	        return cls(params, lr=1e-3), None
430	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — surface any construction failure
431	        return None, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
432	
433	
434	def run_benchmark(args, report) -> dict:
435	    """Time fused vs ATen-baseline optimizer steps over realistic shapes.
436	
437	    CPU paths run now; GPU paths only when CUDA is available. Returns a JSON-
438	    serialisable results dict (also written to `report` as text)."""
439	    try:
440	        import torch
441	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
442	        report.write(f"[bench] torch import failed: {exc}\n")
443	        return {"error": f"torch import failed: {exc}"}
444	
445	    cuda = torch.cuda.is_available()
446	    device = "cuda" if cuda else "cpu"
447	    dtype = torch.float32
448	    _init_aten_baselines()
449	
450	    results: dict = {
451	        "schema": "bench_backends/v1",
452	        "generated": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
453	        "device": device,
454	        "torch": torch.__version__,
455	        "warmup": args.warmup,
456	        "iters": args.iters,
457	        "workloads": [w[0] for w in BENCH_WORKLOADS],
458	        "measurements": [],
459	    }
460	
461	    section(report, f"BENCHMARK — device={device} warmup={args.warmup} "
462	                    f"iters={args.iters}", char="=")
463	    if not cuda:
464	        report.write(
465	            "[bench] no CUDA device — timing the CPU dispatch path. GPU latency "
466	            "numbers require a real accelerator (committed baselines are env-"
467	            "specific and intentionally not checked in).\n")
468	
469	    opts = [o for o in OPTIMIZERS
470	            if not args.filter or args.filter in o[0]]
471	
472	    for opt_short, opt_class, _src in opts:
473	        for wl_name, shapes in BENCH_WORKLOADS:
474	            entry: dict = {
475	                "optimizer": opt_short,
476	                "workload": wl_name,
477	                "n_params": len(shapes),
478	                "n_elements": int(sum(_numel(s) for s in shapes)),
479	            }
480	
481	            # ── fused (project) path ──
482	            params = _make_params(shapes, device, dtype)
483	            opt, why = _build_fused_optimizer(opt_class, params)
484	            if opt is None:
485	                entry["fused"] = {"skipped": why}
486	            else:
487	                def _fused_step(_opt=opt, _params=params):
488	                    _refresh_grads(_params)
489	                    _opt.step()
490	
491	                try:
492	                    lat = _time_callable(_fused_step, warmup=args.warmup,
493	                                         iters=args.iters, cuda=cuda)
494	                    entry["fused"] = _summarize(lat, entry["n_elements"])
495	                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
496	                    entry["fused"] = {"error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
497	
498	            # ── ATen baseline (only where a 1:1 stock optimizer exists) ──
499	            base_factory = ATEN_BASELINE.get(opt_short)
500	            if base_factory is not None:
501	                bparams = _make_params(shapes, device, dtype)
502	                try:
503	                    bopt = base_factory(bparams)
504	
505	                    def _base_step(_opt=bopt, _params=bparams):
506	                        _refresh_grads(_params)
507	                        _opt.step()
508	
509	                    blat = _time_callable(_base_step, warmup=args.warmup,
510	                                          iters=args.iters, cuda=cuda)
511	                    entry["aten_baseline"] = _summarize(blat,
512	                                                        entry["n_elements"])
513	                    # speedup = baseline_median / fused_median (>1 => fused wins)
514	                    f = entry.get("fused", {})
515	                    if "median_ms" in f and f["median_ms"] > 0:
516	                        entry["speedup_vs_aten"] = (
517	                            entry["aten_baseline"]["median_ms"] / f["median_ms"])
518	                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
519	                    entry["aten_baseline"] = {"error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
520	
521	            results["measurements"].append(entry)
522	            _write_bench_row(report, entry)
523	
524	    return results
525	
526	
527	def _numel(shape: Tuple[int, ...]) -> int:
528	    n = 1
529	    for d in shape:
530	        n *= d
531	    return n
532	
533	
534	def _summarize(lat_ms: List[float], n_elements: int) -> dict:
535	    median = statistics.median(lat_ms)
536	    out = {
537	        "median_ms": median,
538	        "p90_ms": _percentile(lat_ms, 90),
539	        "min_ms": min(lat_ms),
540	        "samples": len(lat_ms),
541	    }
542	    # Throughput: elements updated per second at the median latency.
543	    if median > 0:
544	        out["throughput_melem_per_s"] = (n_elements / (median / 1e3)) / 1e6
545	    return out
546	
547	
548	def _write_bench_row(report, entry: dict) -> None:
549	    fused = entry.get("fused", {})
550	    base = entry.get("aten_baseline")
551	    line = (f"  {entry['optimizer']:<12} {entry['workload']:<7} "
552	            f"elems={entry['n_elements']:>11,} ")
553	    if "median_ms" in fused:
554	        line += (f"fused med={fused['median_ms']:.4f}ms "
555	                 f"p90={fused['p90_ms']:.4f}ms "
556	                 f"thr={fused.get('throughput_melem_per_s', 0):.1f}Melem/s")
557	    elif "skipped" in fused:
558	        line += f"fused [skip: {fused['skipped']}]"
559	    elif "error" in fused:
560	        line += f"fused [err: {fused['error']}]"
561	    if base and "median_ms" in base:
562	        line += f" | aten med={base['median_ms']:.4f}ms"
563	        if "speedup_vs_aten" in entry:
564	            line += f" speedup={entry['speedup_vs_aten']:.2f}x"
565	    report.write(line + "\n")
566	    report.flush()
567	
568	
569	def _run_bench_mode(args) -> int:
570	    """Bench mode entry: build (optional), time fused vs ATen, emit text + JSON."""
571	    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
572	    backend = args.backend or detect_backend()
573	    with open(args.output, "w") as report:
574	        report.write("# SuperGrok optimizer bench (timing mode)\n")
575	        report.write(f"# Generated: {datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}\n")
576	        report.write(f"# Backend:   {backend}\n")
577	
578	        if not args.skip_build and backend in ("cuda", "hip"):
579	            try:
580	                import torch
581	                if torch.cuda.is_available():
582	                    build_extension(backend, report)
583	                else:
584	                    report.write("\n[bench] no accelerator — skipping build; "
585	                                 "timing the importable dispatch path.\n")
586	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
587	                report.write("\n[bench] torch unavailable for build phase.\n")
588	        else:
589	            report.write("\n[bench] build phase skipped.\n")
590	        report.flush()
591	
592	        results = run_benchmark(args, report)
593	
594	    if args.json_out is not None:
595	        args.json_out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
596	        with open(args.json_out, "w") as jf:
597	            json.dump(results, jf, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
598	        sys.stderr.write(f"[bench] JSON written: {args.json_out}\n")
599	
600	    sys.stdout.write(f"{args.output}\n")
601	    return 0 if "error" not in results else 1
602	
603	
604	def main() -> int:
605	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
606	        description=__doc__,
607	        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
608	    )
609	    parser.add_argument("--backend", choices=("cuda", "hip", "pallas"),
610	                        default=None,
611	                        help="Force a backend (default: auto-detect)")
612	    parser.add_argument("--output", "-o", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REPORT,
613	                        help=f"Report file (default: {DEFAULT_REPORT.name})")
614	    parser.add_argument("--skip-build", action="store_true",
615	                        help="Skip the pip-install build phase")
616	    parser.add_argument("--filter", default="",
617	                        help="Only run launchers whose name contains this substring")
618	    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=900,
619	                        help="Per-command timeout in seconds (default 900)")
620	    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("bench", "profile"), default="bench",
621	                        help="bench: real warmup+timed latency/throughput "
622	                             "measurement vs an ATen baseline (default). "
623	                             "profile: the legacy ncu/rocprof/jax profiler dump.")
624	    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10,
625	                        help="Warmup iterations before timing (bench mode)")
626	    parser.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=50,
627	                        help="Timed iterations per (optimizer, workload) "
628	                             "(bench mode)")
629	    parser.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out", type=Path, default=None,
630	                        help="Write the bench results to this JSON file "
631	                             "(committed-baseline format; numbers are env-"
632	                             "specific so don't commit GPU numbers from CI)")
633	    args = parser.parse_args()
634	
635	    if args.mode == "bench":
636	        return _run_bench_mode(args)
637	
638	    backend = args.backend or detect_backend()
639	    launchers = list_launchers(backend)
640	    if args.filter:
641	        launchers = [p for p in launchers if args.filter in p.name]
642	
643	    if not launchers:
644	        sys.stderr.write(
645	            f"No launchers matched (backend={backend}, filter={args.filter!r})\n"
646	        )
647	        return 1
648	
649	    try:
650	        from tqdm import tqdm
651	        progress = lambda it: tqdm(it, desc=f"Profile {backend}",
652	                                    file=sys.stderr, unit="launcher",
653	                                    bar_format="{l_bar}{bar}| {n_fmt}/{total_fmt} "
654	                                               "[{elapsed}<{remaining}, {rate_fmt}]")
655	    except ImportError:
656	        # Built-in ETA fallback: emits "[i/N elapsed=Xs eta=Ys] <name>" per launcher
657	        import time as _t
658	
659	        def progress(it):
660	            items = list(it)
661	            n = len(items)
662	            t0 = _t.monotonic()
663	            for i, x in enumerate(items, 1):
664	                elapsed = _t.monotonic() - t0
665	                eta = (elapsed / max(i - 1, 1)) * (n - i + 1) if i > 1 else 0.0
666	                sys.stderr.write(
667	                    f"\r[{i}/{n} elapsed={elapsed:5.1f}s eta={eta:5.1f}s] "
668	                    f"{getattr(x, 'name', str(x)):40s}"
669	                )
670	                sys.stderr.flush()
671	                yield x
672	            sys.stderr.write("\n")
673	
674	    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
675	    profiler_name = {
676	        "cuda": "ncu (Nsight Compute)",
677	        "hip":  "rocprof-compute / rocprofv2",
678	        "pallas": "jax.profiler",
679	    }[backend]
680	
681	    with open(args.output, "w") as report:
682	        report.write("# SuperGrok backend bench report\n")
683	        report.write(f"# Generated: {datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}\n")
684	        report.write(f"# Backend:   {backend}\n")
685	        report.write(f"# CPU cores: {NCPUS} (used for ninja -j)\n")
686	        report.write(f"# Profiler:  {profiler_name}\n")
687	        report.write(f"# Launchers: {len(launchers)}\n")
688	        report.write(f"# Repo:      {REPO_ROOT}\n")
689	
690	        if not args.skip_build:
691	            ok = build_extension(backend, report)
692	            if not ok:
693	                report.write(
694	                    "\n[!] Build returned non-zero — continuing to per-launcher "
695	                    "phase regardless (profiler runs may still surface errors).\n"
696	                )
697	        else:
698	            report.write("\n[skip-build] reusing already-installed _ops\n")
699	
700	        report.flush()
701	
702	        for path in progress(launchers):
703	            tup = opt_for_launcher(path)
704	            section(report, f"LAUNCHER: {path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}", char="-")
705	            if tup is None:
706	                report.write(f"[!] No optimizer mapping for {path.name}; skipping\n")
707	                continue
708	            opt_short, opt_class, source_mod = tup
709	            report.write(f"  optimizer:  {opt_class}\n")
710	            report.write(f"  source:     {source_mod}\n")
711	            script = make_smoke_script(opt_short, opt_class, source_mod, backend)
712	            report.write(f"  smoke script:\n{textwrap.indent(script, '    ')}\n")
713	
714	            if backend == "cuda":
715	                profile_cuda(script, report, opt_short)
716	            elif backend == "hip":
717	                profile_hip(script, report, opt_short)
718	            else:
719	                profile_pallas(script, report, opt_short)
720	
721	            report.flush()
722	
723	    sys.stdout.write(f"{args.output}\n")
724	    return 0
725	
726	
727	if __name__ == "__main__":
728	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# build.sh — top-level build wrapper for grokking-optimizers.
3	#
4	# Usage:
5	#   ./build.sh                    # default: plain release build
6	#   ./build.sh --debug            # -G -O0 -lineinfo, fast-math off (CUDA_DEBUG=1)
7	#   ./build.sh --profile          # release build, then ncu --set full
8	#   ./build.sh --package          # build + stage redistributable dist/ tree
9	#   ./build.sh --package-tarball  # --package + supergrok2-VERSION-SHA.tar.gz
10	#
11	# Env:
12	#   MAX_JOBS   parallel ninja jobs (default: $(nproc))
13	#
14	# AUTOTUNING (the old --autotune two-pass flow was REMOVED — it called a
15	# nonexistent autotune/tune.py and staged the wrong header path). The kernel
16	# autotuner is now grokking_optimizers.compile: it JIT-builds + times variants
17	# and writes the winners to grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json. The NEXT
18	# plain `./build.sh` (or `pip install -e .`) reads that JSON and injects the
19	# per-TU -DSG_TUNED_* / --maxrregcount flags into the shipped _ops*.so. Full
20	# operator procedure: see AUTOTUNE_LINKAGE.md. In short:
21	#     python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --optimizer <opt> --model <model> \
22	#         --arch sm_90 --jit-only      # repeat per optimizer -> _kernel_tuned.json
23	#     ./build.sh                       # rebuild; tuned flags are now active
24	#
25	# --package combines well with --debug. Combining with --debug skips the strip
26	# step so the extensions stay debuggable.
27	#
28	# The ninja invocation by torch's BuildExtension prints "[N/M] ..." progress
29	# lines on stderr. We tee everything to build.log and post-process with a
30	# tqdm filter to render percent + ETA. Non-progress lines pass through to
31	# the terminal as-is.
32	
33	set -euo pipefail
34	
35	cd "$(dirname "$0")"
36	
37	# Caching + auto-threaded nvcc + ninja: source the fast-build env if present so a plain
38	# ./build.sh gets the device(sccache)/host(ccache) compile cache + nvcc --threads 0 for free.
39	if [[ -f .fast_build_env.sh ]]; then
40	  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
41	  source .fast_build_env.sh
42	fi
43	
44	DEBUG=0
45	PROFILE=0
46	PACKAGE=0
47	TARBALL=0
48	
49	for arg in "$@"; do
50	  case "$arg" in
51	    --debug)           DEBUG=1 ;;
52	    --profile)         PROFILE=1 ;;
53	    --package)         PACKAGE=1 ;;
54	    --package-tarball) PACKAGE=1; TARBALL=1 ;;
55	    --autotune|--no-autotune)
56	      # Removed: the two-pass --autotune flow called a nonexistent
57	      # autotune/tune.py and staged the wrong tuned-header path. The kernel
58	      # autotuner is now `python -m grokking_optimizers.compile` writing
59	      # grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json, which the NEXT plain build
60	      # consumes automatically. See AUTOTUNE_LINKAGE.md.
61	      echo "build.sh: '$arg' has been removed." >&2
62	      echo "  Run the autotuner, then rebuild:" >&2
63	      echo "    python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --optimizer <opt> \\" >&2
64	      echo "        --model <model> --arch sm_90 --jit-only   # per optimizer" >&2
65	      echo "    ./build.sh                                     # tuned flags active" >&2
66	      echo "  Details: AUTOTUNE_LINKAGE.md" >&2
67	      exit 2
68	      ;;
69	    -h|--help)
70	      sed -n '2,28p' "$0"
71	      exit 0
72	      ;;
73	    *)
74	      echo "build.sh: unknown flag: $arg" >&2
75	      exit 2
76	      ;;
77	  esac
78	done
79	
80	: "${MAX_JOBS:=$(nproc)}"
81	export MAX_JOBS
82	echo "build.sh: MAX_JOBS=${MAX_JOBS}"
83	
84	if [[ "$DEBUG" == "1" ]]; then
85	  export CUDA_DEBUG=1
86	  echo "build.sh: CUDA_DEBUG=1 (debug build, fast-math disabled)"
87	else
88	  unset CUDA_DEBUG || true
89	fi
90	
91	# tqdm-aware progress filter for ninja's "[N/M] ..." lines.
92	# Non-progress lines are passed through unchanged. If tqdm or python is
93	# missing we fall back to plain tee.
94	PROGRESS_FILTER=$(cat <<'PYEOF'
95	import re, sys
96	try:
97	    from tqdm import tqdm
98	except ImportError:
99	    for line in sys.stdin:
100	        sys.stdout.write(line)
101	        sys.stdout.flush()
102	    sys.exit(0)
103	
104	pat = re.compile(r"^\s*\[(\d+)/(\d+)\]")
105	bar = None
106	last_total = None
107	for line in sys.stdin:
108	    m = pat.match(line)
109	    if m:
110	        cur, total = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
111	        if bar is None or total != last_total:
112	            if bar is not None:
113	                bar.close()
114	            bar = tqdm(total=total, unit="obj", dynamic_ncols=True,
115	                       desc="ninja", leave=True)
116	            last_total = total
117	            bar.n = cur
118	        else:
119	            bar.n = cur
120	        bar.refresh()
121	        # also keep the raw line in build.log via tee upstream
122	    else:
123	        if bar is not None:
124	            bar.clear()
125	        sys.stdout.write(line)
126	        sys.stdout.flush()
127	        if bar is not None:
128	            bar.refresh()
129	if bar is not None:
130	    bar.close()

155	# TunedBuildExtension injects the per-TU tuned flags automatically. If the JSON

166	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
167	# --package: stage a redistributable dist/ tree mirroring the runtime layout.
168	#
169	# Output layout (matches what Python sees after `pip install -e .`):
170	#   dist/
171	#   ├── grokking_optimizers/        Python sources + compiled _ops.<...>.so
172	#   │                               (+ _kernel_tuned.json if winners exist)
173	#   ├── csrc/backends/pallas/       Pallas/JAX TPU kernels (Python)
174	#   ├── LICENSE
175	#   ├── pyproject.toml              build manifest (version pin)
176	#   ├── README.md
177	#   └── INSTALL.md                  auto-generated install guide (if template)
178	#
179	# Stage-2 fix (Phase 8): earlier revisions staged `supergrok2_jax_tpu/` and
180	# `csrc/kernels/tpu/` — neither path exists in this tree. The JAX/TPU Pallas
181	# kernels actually live under `csrc/backends/pallas/`. Staging is guarded on
182	# existence so a plain `--package` never creates empty directories.
183	#
184	# Tuned provenance: the tuned launch params are BAKED INTO the .so at build
185	# time (TunedBuildExtension, lever (b)). The canonical winners file
186	# grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json is staged alongside the .so when it
187	# exists so a consumer can see / re-apply what was tuned. (The legacy
188	# csrc/common/tuned_configs.h staging was wrong — compile.py writes
189	# csrc/algorithms/tuned_configs.h, a secondary header — and is dropped.)
190	#
191	# Compiled extensions: torch's BuildExtension produces a single multi-arch
192	# fatbin .so (one file with cubin/PTX for every arch listed in setup.py's
193	# -gencode + --offload-arch flags). The driver picks the right cubin at
194	# load time. If WITH_CUTLASS=1 was set, that .so links CUTLASS in.
195	# Debug symbols are stripped unless --debug was set.
196	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
197	package_dist() {
198	  local dist_dir="dist"
199	  echo "build.sh: --package staging into ${dist_dir}/"
200	  rm -rf "${dist_dir}"
201	  mkdir -p "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers"
202	
203	  # Python sources (preserve subpackage layout, including kernel headers).
204	  cp -r grokking_optimizers/*.py "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers/"
205	  # Canonical tuned winners (lever (b)). The launch params are already baked
206	  # into the .so; this file records WHAT was tuned (provenance / re-apply).
207	  if [[ -f grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json ]]; then
208	    cp grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers/"
209	  fi
210	  # Per-arch in-package kernel headers (*.cuh / *.hip.hpp) and any package
211	  # data live under grokking_optimizers/kernels/ — copy the whole subpackage.
212	  if [[ -d grokking_optimizers/kernels ]]; then
213	    cp -r grokking_optimizers/kernels "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers/"
214	  fi
215	  if [[ -d grokking_optimizers/optimizers ]]; then
216	    cp -r grokking_optimizers/optimizers "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers/"
217	  fi
218	
219	  # JAX/TPU Pallas kernels (Python). These live under csrc/backends/pallas/,
220	  # not the long-gone csrc/kernels/tpu/ or supergrok2_jax_tpu/ paths.
221	  if [[ -d csrc/backends/pallas ]]; then
222	    mkdir -p "${dist_dir}/csrc/backends/pallas"
223	    cp -r csrc/backends/pallas/* "${dist_dir}/csrc/backends/pallas/" 2>/dev/null || true
224	  fi
225	
226	  # Math manifest consumed by the autotuner / kernel emitter.
227	  if [[ -f scripts/optimizer_math_manifest.json ]]; then
228	    mkdir -p "${dist_dir}/scripts"
229	    cp scripts/optimizer_math_manifest.json "${dist_dir}/scripts/"
230	  fi
231	
232	  # Compiled extension(s). pip install -e . places the .so directly under
233	  # grokking_optimizers/ (in-place editable install).
234	  shopt -s nullglob
235	  local ops_files=( grokking_optimizers/_ops*.so grokking_optimizers/_ops*.pyd )
236	  shopt -u nullglob
237	  if [[ ${#ops_files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
238	    echo "build.sh: --package: no compiled _ops.* extension found" >&2
239	    echo "  Expected grokking_optimizers/_ops*.{so,pyd} after a successful build." >&2
240	    exit 3
241	  fi
242	  for f in "${ops_files[@]}"; do
243	    cp "$f" "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers/"
244	  done
245	  echo "build.sh: --package staged ${#ops_files[@]} _ops extension(s)"
246	
247	  # (The tuned launch params are baked into the .so above and the canonical
248	  # winners file grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json is staged with the
249	  # Python sources. There is no separate csrc/common/tuned_configs.h to ship —
250	  # that path was never written by the autotuner.)
251	
252	  # Top-level metadata. (REFRESH.md does not exist in this tree; LICENSE is
253	  # required by the package metadata, so it must ship.)
254	  for f in pyproject.toml README.md LICENSE; do
255	    [[ -f "$f" ]] && cp "$f" "${dist_dir}/"
256	  done
257	
258	  # Strip debug symbols unless --debug.
259	  if [[ "$DEBUG" != "1" ]]; then
260	    for f in "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers"/_ops*.so; do
261	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
262	      strip --strip-unneeded "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
263	    done
264	    echo "build.sh: --package stripped debug symbols (run with --debug to keep)"
265	  else
266	    echo "build.sh: --package kept debug symbols (--debug was set)"
267	  fi
268	
269	  # Generate INSTALL.md from the template.
270	  if [[ -f scripts/INSTALL.md.template ]]; then
271	    cp scripts/INSTALL.md.template "${dist_dir}/INSTALL.md"
272	  fi
273	
274	  # Size report.
275	  local total_bytes
276	  total_bytes=$(du -sb "${dist_dir}" | awk '{print $1}')
277	  local total_mib=$(( total_bytes / 1024 / 1024 ))
278	  echo "build.sh: --package complete. dist/ size: ${total_mib} MiB"
279	  du -sh "${dist_dir}/grokking_optimizers"/_ops*.so 2>/dev/null | while read -r sz f; do
280	    echo "  ${f}: ${sz}"
281	  done
282	}

1	# Fast-iteration build env for the SuperGrok1.5 perf ratchet: caching + auto-threaded nvcc + ninja.
2	# Source this BEFORE any build/gate/roofline_bench/compile command:   source .fast_build_env.sh
3	#
4	# WHAT IT FIXES (each verified 2026-06-16):
5	#  1. DEVICE-COMPILE CACHE — the expensive cu->cubin (~200s/TU). torch called nvcc DIRECTLY, so
6	#     sccache never saw it (0 requests). We route nvcc through sccache via torch's PYTORCH_NVCC
7	#     hook (cpp_extension.py L2308 — used by BOTH the JIT bench path and the AOT _ops build).
8	#     The wrapper .build_tools/nvcc-cached execs `sccache nvcc` => CUDA-native cache (verified
9	#     100% hit on a recompiled config, "Cache hits (CUDA)").
10	#  2. HOST-COMPILE CACHE — the C++ bindings/stubs. CXX="ccache g++"; torch's COLLECT_GCC probe
11	#     (L322) sees through the wrapper so its ABI check still passes.
12	#  3. AUTO-THREADED nvcc — the wrapper adds `--threads 0`, so nvcc auto-detects the machine's
13	#     CPU count (parallel gencode/compile phases). Replaces the old FIXED, IGNORED NVCC_THREADS=8
14	#     (torch 2.4.1 never forwarded NVCC_THREADS).
15	#  4. NINJA + MAX_JOBS — torch uses ninja by default; MAX_JOBS=$(nproc) parallelizes TUs.
16	#  Together (1)+(2) = the FULL compile is cached (device + host), not part of it.
17	#
18	# The gendeps unblock is still required: torch's --generate-dependencies-with-compile makes the
19	# nvcc command non-cacheable for sccache; TORCH_EXTENSION_SKIP_NVCC_GEN_DEPENDENCIES=1 strips it.
20	# Cache-hit CORRECTNESS is unaffected: caches hash the PREPROCESSED source, so any header/macro
21	# change forces a real recompile (a stale hit is impossible).
22	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}")" && pwd)"
23	export PATH="/workspace/.local/bin:$PATH"                 # sccache lives here
24	# FIX (2026-06-17): torch's check_compiler_ok_for_platform (cpp_extension.py L320) runs
25	# `<basename CXX> -v`, i.e. the BARE name `g++-cached`, NOT the full $CXX path. The wrapper is
26	# at $ROOT/.build_tools/g++-cached which is on no PATH dir, so the autotuner's --jit-only build
27	# died at the ABI probe ("g++-cached: command not found") for EVERY cell. (The bench/load() path
28	# tolerated the full path, which is why the re-profile built fine.) Symlink the wrapper into the
29	# PATH dir so the basename resolves too — keeps full nvcc+ccache caching intact.
30	mkdir -p /workspace/.local/bin 2>/dev/null
31	ln -sf "$ROOT/.build_tools/g++-cached" /workspace/.local/bin/g++-cached 2>/dev/null || true
32	export TORCH_EXTENSION_SKIP_NVCC_GEN_DEPENDENCIES=1        # unblock: strip the gendeps flag
33	export PYTORCH_NVCC="$ROOT/.build_tools/nvcc-cached"       # nvcc -> sccache + --threads 0 (device)
34	export CXX="$ROOT/.build_tools/g++-cached"                 # g++ -> ccache (host stubs); single-token path for torch's which()
35	export SCCACHE_DIR="$ROOT/.build_cache/sccache"   # PERSISTENT (was /dev/shm ramdisk -> wiped on instance close). Volume-backed so fast-recompile survives across sessions.
36	export SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE=20G
37	export CCACHE_DIR="$ROOT/.build_cache/ccache"     # PERSISTENT (volume-backed, survives instance close)
38	export CCACHE_MAXSIZE=10G
39	export CCACHE_SLOPPINESS=time_macros,include_file_mtime,include_file_ctime
40	export TMPDIR=/dev/shm/tmp                                 # nvcc cicc/ptxas scratch on ramdisk
41	export MAX_JOBS="$(nproc)"                                 # ninja TU parallelism (auto-detect)
42	unset NVCC_THREADS 2>/dev/null || true                    # superseded by --threads 0 in the wrapper
43	mkdir -p /dev/shm/tmp "$ROOT/.build_cache/sccache" "$ROOT/.build_cache/ccache" 2>/dev/null
44	command -v sccache >/dev/null 2>&1 && sccache --start-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
45	echo "[fast-build-env] caching ON: nvcc->sccache(CUDA) + g++->ccache | nvcc --threads 0 (auto=$(nproc)) | MAX_JOBS=$(nproc) | ninja"

1	# compile_config.toml — the GROKKING project's autotune / build configuration,
2	# made EXPLICIT.
3	#
4	# WHAT THIS IS
5	#   grokking_optimizers/compile.py carries an inlined `_DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG`
6	#   that already encodes the SuperGrok project's historical build behaviour. This
7	#   file mirrors that default verbatim so the configuration is (a) visible and
8	#   version-controlled in one place instead of buried in a 30k-line module, and
9	#   (b) a worked reference example of the PORTABLE config schema a foreign project
10	#   would drop in to retarget compile.py at its own kernels.
11	#
12	# HOW IT IS LOADED
13	#   compile.load_config() deep-merges, in priority order:
14	#       caller --config path  >  ./compile_config.toml (this file, CWD)  >  _DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG
15	#   so this file in the repo root is picked up automatically (CWD_CONFIG_NAME =
16	#   "compile_config.toml"). Because it reproduces the inlined defaults, a build
17	#   with or without it is byte-identical — its job is documentation + proving the
18	#   config path, not changing behaviour. apply_to_buildspec() copies the keys
19	#   below onto the BuildSpec; sections/keys it does not recognise are merged and
20	#   preserved but otherwise ignored (so the documentary [tuned_macros] table at
21	#   the end is safe).
22	#
23	# NOTE ON TYPES: TOML has no null. Keys whose _DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG value is
24	#   None (e.g. autotune.max_seconds) are OMITTED here so the merge keeps the
25	#   built-in None rather than forcing an invalid literal.
26	
27	[project]
28	name    = "supergrok"
29	version = "2.0.0"
30	# Prefix prepended to every -D gating macro emitted by _build_macros
31	# (e.g. -DSG_BUILD_OPTIMIZER_LION). MUST be a legal C-identifier fragment ending
32	# in '_' (apply_to_buildspec warns otherwise).
33	macro_prefix = "SG_BUILD_"
34	# torch.ops template the numerical-validation subprocesses use to look up the
35	# AOT / variant fused step kernel. Placeholders: {opt} {opt_lower} {opt_upper}.
36	fused_op_template = "torch.ops.grokking_optimizers.fused_{opt_lower}_simple_step"
37	# PORTABLE tune-hook (schema-agnostic autotune seam): "pkg.module:fn" with
38	#   fn(*, so_path, model, optimizer, arch, regime, seed)
39	#       -> {"output": np.ndarray, "elapsed_ms": float}
40	# used for BOTH reference capture and variant run+time+validate. The grokking
41	# default points at the L3-TC megakernel driver. Empty string disables it (falls
42	# back to the torch.op-template numerical path).
43	tune_hook = "grokking_optimizers.tune_hook:run"
44	# Python package the worker / timing / pgo subprocesses import to resolve the
45	# optimizer class (e.g. `from grokking_optimizers import Lion`).
46	python_package = "grokking_optimizers"
47	# C++ namespace surfaced into the Jinja2 template context as `project_namespace`.
48	# Empty string preserves today's templates (none reference it).
49	namespace = ""
50	
51	[sources]
52	# Per-vendor device source roots (project_sources appends /<arch> for cuda/hip).
53	cuda_root      = "csrc/backends/cuda"
54	hip_root       = "csrc/backends/hip"
55	pallas_root    = "csrc/backends/pallas"
56	algorithms_dir = "csrc/algorithms"
57	bindings_dir   = "csrc/bindings"
58	# Destination for _write_tuned_configs_header (absolute, or repo-root-relative).
59	tuned_header_path = "csrc/algorithms/tuned_configs.h"
60	
61	[sources.include_paths]
62	# Extra -I roots. MUST be a list of strings (apply_to_buildspec type-checks this).
63	extra = []
64	
65	# NDEBUG migration: compile.py's base device flags carry NO project opinion. The
66	# grokking project's -DNDEBUG (assert-stripping; de-serializes the WGMMA mainloop)
67	# is an explicit, tracked decision recorded HERE and appended to the device flags
68	# by _project_device_extra_flags. CUDA_DEBUG strips it in setup.py to restore
69	# asserts. A config-less generic build gets no -DNDEBUG.
70	[device_cflags]
71	extra = ["-DNDEBUG"]
72	
73	[optimizers]
74	# Restricts the CLI choices + which optimizer TUs are built/tuned. Mirrors
75	# dispatch.OPTIMIZERS / the inlined default. Empty list => fall back to the full
76	# profile list.
77	enabled = [
78	    "adamw", "lion", "muon", "prodigy", "grokadamw",
79	    "grokfast", "looksam", "neuralgrok",
80	    "supergrok11", "supergrok15", "supergrok2",
81	]
82	
83	[models]
84	# SHORT user-API model names (canonicalize_model maps them to the canonical
85	# internal "transformer_decoder" / "mamba3" / "vit" at dispatch boundaries).
86	enabled = ["mamba", "decoder", "vit"]
87	
88	[archs]
89	default = "sm_90a"
90	# Empty => no allow-list restriction (every arch profile.ARCHS knows is allowed).
91	allowed = []
92	
93	[pgo]
94	workload_script = ""
95	steps = 1000
96	
97	[autotune]
98	min_improvement = 0.005
99	patience = 0
100	# max_seconds is None in the inlined default ("no wall-clock cap"); OMITTED here
101	# because TOML has no null and the merge must keep that None, not coerce it.
102	
103	[codegen]
104	enable_emitter = false
105	template_dir = "grokking_optimizers/templates"
106	# Template override map: keys "<opt>" or "<opt>:<arch_or_vendor>"; values are
107	# bundled template names or absolute .j2 paths. Empty => historical probe order.
108	template_overrides = {}
109	
110	# Stream D — generative / structural codegen. Master switch OFF => byte-identical
111	# to a no-synthesis build.
112	[synth_codegen]
113	enable = false
114	allowed_patterns = [
115	    "adamw_update", "fused_adam_grad_norm", "softmax_matmul",
116	    "reduce_broadcast", "parallel_scan", "bilevel_fusion",
117	]
118	max_fusion_depth = 3
119	prefer_synth_over_template = false
120	
121	[runtime_specialization]
122	enable = false
123	cache_dir = ""
124	
125	[device_pgo]
126	enable = false
127	
128	[cache]
129	auto_prune_after_jit = true
130	max_age_days = 30
131	keep_top_n = 100
132	
133	[numerics]
134	strict = false
135	
136	# Stream B — polyhedral / loop-transform scheduling search. OFF by default
137	# (libclang + islpy soft deps; multiplies the search space).
138	[polyhedral]
139	enable = false
140	max_schedules_per_template = 16
141	allowed_transforms = ["tile", "fuse", "reorder", "vectorize", "parallelize"]
142	tile_size_candidates = [16, 32, 64, 128]
143	
144	# Stream C — learned cost model. Every key OFF / inert by default (strictly
145	# additive: omitting this section is byte-identical to disabling it).
146	[cost_model]
147	enable = false
148	retrain_every = 20
149	rejection_threshold_x = 3.0
150	rejection_max_pct = 0.8
151	uncertainty_method = "bootstrap"
152	
153	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
154	# DOCUMENTARY — the LIVE sm_90 tuned-macro floor.
155	#
156	# This section is NOT consumed by compile.py (apply_to_buildspec ignores unknown
157	# sections — the merge just preserves it). It records, in one human-readable
158	# place, the SAFE per-TU floor that the autotuner's winning launch params flow
159	# into: each maps an autotuner search-space dim NAME (compile.py `_dim(...,
160	# macro=...)`) to the -DSG_TUNED_* macro the committed sm_90 kernels read via a
161	# live `#ifndef SG_TUNED_*` guard, plus its in-source default. The AUTHORITATIVE
162	# copy lives in grokking_optimizers/_tuned_inject.py::MACROS (the producer/
163	# consumer source of truth); this mirror exists so a reader of the project config
164	# can see what gets tuned without grepping the device tree. The previous dead set
165	# (SG_TUNED_BLOCK_SIZE / VEC_WIDTH / UNROLL / ASYNC_DEPTH) guarded the DELETED
166	# eager kernels/sm_90/*_sm90.cuh headers and is gone.
167	#
168	# Format: dim = ["MACRO", default]. maxrregcount is a real ptxas flag
169	# (--maxrregcount=N), not a -D macro; 0 means "unset / emit nothing".
170	[tuned_macros.macros]
171	mega_block    = ["SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK", 256]    # csrc/fused/megakernel_common.cuh
172	tile_m        = ["SG_TUNED_TILE_M", 128]        # csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/wgmma.cuh
173	tile_n        = ["SG_TUNED_TILE_N", 128]        # csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/wgmma.cuh
174	dec_dw_splitk = ["SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_SPLITK", 4]   # csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh
175	vit_dw_splitk = ["SG_TUNED_VIT_DW_SPLITK", 4]   # csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_vit_tc.cuh
176	mb_dw_splitk  = ["SG_TUNED_MB_DW_SPLITK", 4]    # csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_mamba_tc.cuh
177	prod_regs     = ["SG_TUNED_PROD_REGS", 40]      # csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/tile_pipeline.cuh
178	cons_regs     = ["SG_TUNED_CONS_REGS", 232]     # csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/tile_pipeline.cuh
179	
180	[tuned_macros.flags]
181	# ptxas codegen flag (no -D macro). 0 == unset == nvcc's own register allocator.
182	maxrregcount = ["--maxrregcount", 0]
183
