388	def phase4_maximality(rep: Report) -> None:
389	    sys.stdout.write("\n[PHASE 4] MAXIMALITY — max fusion tier, idempotency, "
390	                     "budget, single-source\n")
391	
392	    plans = mk.solve_all()
393	    by_arch_tier: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {a: {} for a in ARCHES}
394	
395	    # 4a. Every cell is FEASIBLE (>= L1) — no infeasible compositions.
396	    infeasible = [p for p in plans if not p.fits]
397	    rep.add(Check("4", f"all {N_CELLS} cells feasible (≥L1)",
398	                  PASS if not infeasible else FAIL,
399	                  "" if not infeasible
400	                  else f"{len(infeasible)} infeasible: "
401	                       f"{[(p.model, p.optimizer, p.arch) for p in infeasible][:3]}"))
402	
403	    # 4b. Every cell sits at the MAX tier that fits its budget (the solver's
404	    # job — re-derive independently and confirm no cell could go higher).
405	    not_maximal: List[str] = []
406	    for p in plans:
407	        tier = p.tier
408	        by_arch_tier[p.arch][tier.name] = \
409	            by_arch_tier[p.arch].get(tier.name, 0) + 1
410	        if p.arch == "tpu_v6e":
411	            continue  # XLA-managed; solver reports L3 by construction.
412	        b = mk._arch_budget(p.arch)
413	        # Could a strictly higher tier have fit? If so, the solver under-fused.
414	        for higher in (mk.FusionTier.L3_FWD_BWD_OPT, mk.FusionTier.L2_BWD_OPT):
415	            if higher <= tier:
416	                continue
417	            hr, hs = mk._tier_cost(p.model, p.optimizer, higher)
418	            if hr <= b.max_regs_per_thread and hs <= b.max_smem_per_block:
419	                not_maximal.append(
420	                    f"{p.model}/{p.optimizer}/{p.arch}: at {tier.name} but "
421	                    f"{higher.name} fits ({hr}r/{hs}s)")
422	    rep.add(Check("4", "every cell at its MAX feasible tier",
423	                  PASS if not not_maximal else FAIL,
424	                  "" if not not_maximal else "; ".join(not_maximal[:3])))
425	    rep.tier_map = by_arch_tier
426	
427	    # 4c. Each cell within the arch register + smem budget at its chosen tier.
428	    over_budget: List[str] = []
429	    for p in plans:
430	        if p.arch == "tpu_v6e":
431	            continue
432	        b = mk._arch_budget(p.arch)
433	        if p.regs > b.max_regs_per_thread or p.smem > b.max_smem_per_block:
434	            over_budget.append(
435	                f"{p.model}/{p.optimizer}/{p.arch}: {p.regs}r/{p.smem}s "
436	                f"> {b.max_regs_per_thread}r/{b.max_smem_per_block}s")
437	    rep.add(Check("4", "every cell within register+smem budget",
438	                  PASS if not over_budget else FAIL,
439	                  "" if not over_budget else "; ".join(over_budget[:3])))
440	
441	    # 4d. CODEGEN IDEMPOTENCY: re-emit every cell in memory and assert it is
442	    # byte-identical to the committed file (no drift, no stale generated code).
443	    drifted: List[str] = []
444	    for p in plans:
445	        path = _cell_path(p.model, p.optimizer, p.arch)
446	        if not path.exists():
447	            drifted.append(f"{path.name} (missing)")
448	            continue
449	        emitted = cg.emit_cell(p.model, p.optimizer, p.arch)
450	        if emitted.rstrip() != path.read_text().rstrip():
451	            drifted.append(path.name)
452	    rep.add(Check("4", f"codegen idempotency ({N_CELLS} cells byte-identical)",
453	                  PASS if not drifted else FAIL,
454	                  "" if not drifted
455	                  else f"{len(drifted)} drifted: {drifted[:5]}"))
456	
457	    # 4e. The committed cell's tier COMMENT matches the solver's live decision
458	    # (catches a stale generated header even if the body is right).
459	    tier_mismatch: List[str] = []
460	    for p in plans:
461	        path = _cell_path(p.model, p.optimizer, p.arch)
462	        if not path.exists():
463	            continue
464	        head = path.read_text()[:400]
465	        if p.tier.name not in head and _short_tier(p.tier) not in head:
466	            tier_mismatch.append(f"{path.name} (want {p.tier.name})")
467	    rep.add(Check("4", "cell tier-comment matches solver",
468	                  PASS if not tier_mismatch else FAIL,
469	                  "" if not tier_mismatch else f"{tier_mismatch[:5]}"))
470	
471	    # 4f. Math single-source drift guard (the optimizer math is shared between
472	    # per-op and fused paths — maximal reuse, zero divergence).
473	    rc, out = _run([sys.executable, "scripts/check_math_single_source.py"],
474	                   timeout=120)
475	    rep.add(Check("4", "optimizer-math single-source drift guard",
476	                  PASS if rc == 0 else FAIL,
477	                  "" if rc == 0 else _first_error(out)))
478

493	    # 5a. The three dispatch tables match their generators byte-for-byte.
494	    pairs = [
495	        ("sm_90 dispatch table", "csrc/fused/sm_90/fused_dispatch_table.inc",
496	         cg.dispatch_table_sm90),
497	        ("gfx942 dispatch table", "csrc/fused/gfx942/fused_dispatch_table.inc",
498	         cg.dispatch_table_gfx942),
499	        ("wired_fused_cells", "csrc/fused/fused_wired_cells.inc",
500	         cg.dispatch_table),
501	    ]
502	    for label, path, gen in pairs:
503	        committed = (REPO_ROOT / path).read_text()
504	        rep.add(Check("5", label,
505	                      PASS if gen().rstrip() == committed.rstrip() else FAIL,
506	                      "" if gen().rstrip() == committed.rstrip()
507	                      else "generator output differs from committed file"))
508	
509	    # 5b. fused_wired_cells routes every (arch,model,opt) the solver knows and
510	    # carries no stale tpu_v5p.
511	    wired = (REPO_ROOT / "csrc/fused/fused_wired_cells.inc").read_text()
512	    rep.add(Check("5", "no stale tpu_v5p in active dispatch",
513	                  PASS if "tpu_v5p" not in wired else FAIL))
514	    # Check the ACTUAL per-pair route literal for each GPU arch the wired
515	    # function dispatches (sm_90 + gfx942; TPU is dispatched separately). The
516	    # old check used `+{o}: in wired or '"{m}' in wired and {m}+{o} in wired`,
517	    # whose `A or (B and C)` form (with A/B near-always False because every
518	    # opt/model appears under *some* pair) could not detect a specific
519	    # (model,opt) route being dropped — a reproduced false-green. The route
520	    # literals look like "l3:transformer_decoder+adamw:sm_90".
521	    _GPU_ARCH_SUFFIXES = ("sm_90", "gfx942")
522	    route_miss = [f"{m}+{o}:{suf}"
523	                  for m in MODELS for o in OPTIMIZERS
524	                  for suf in _GPU_ARCH_SUFFIXES
525	                  if f"{m}+{o}:{suf}" not in wired]
526	    rep.add(Check("5", "wired table routes all model+opt pairs",
527	                  PASS if not route_miss else FAIL,
528	                  "" if not route_miss else f"{route_miss[:5]}"))
529	
530	    # 5c. Self-test suite (authoritative count guard inside compile.py).
531	    rc, out = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "grokking_optimizers.compile",
532	                    "--self-test"], timeout=600)
533	    # Match the real summary line: `"0 failed"` as a substring also matches
534	    # "10 failed"/"20 failed"/etc., so anchor on the full "N passed, 0 failed".
535	    ok = rc == 0 and bool(re.search(r"\b[1-9][0-9]* passed, 0 failed\b", out))
536	    summary = next((ln for ln in out.splitlines()
537	                    if "passed," in ln and "failed" in ln), "")
538	    rep.add(Check("5", "compile.py --self-test",
539	                  PASS if ok else FAIL, summary.strip()))
540	
541	    # 5d. ruff lint clean across the package + scripts.
542	    if shutil.which("ruff"):
543	        rc, out = _run(["ruff", "check", "grokking_optimizers/", "scripts/"],
544	                       timeout=120)
545	        rep.add(Check("5", "ruff lint clean",
546	                      PASS if rc == 0 else FAIL,
547	                      "" if rc == 0 else _first_error(out)))
548	    else:
549	        rep.add(Check("5", "ruff lint", SKIP, "ruff absent"))
550	
551	    # 5e. utilization crash-hard contract still holds (no device here → raises).
552	    try:
553	        from grokking_optimizers import utilization as u
554	        raised = False
555	        try:
556	            u.track_cell("adamw", "mamba", "sm_90a", iters=1, timeout=10)
557	        except RuntimeError:
558	            raised = True
559	        rep.add(Check("5", "utilization crash-hard (raises w/o device)",
560	                      PASS if raised else FAIL,
561	                      "" if raised else "track_cell did not raise"))
562	    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
563	        rep.add(Check("5", "utilization crash-hard", FAIL, str(exc)[:200]))
564	
565	
566	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
567	# PHASE 6 — report
568	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
569	
570	def phase6_report(rep: Report, tc: Toolchain, started: float) -> int:
571	    sys.stdout.write("\n" + "=" * 74 + "\n")
572	    sys.stdout.write("VERIFY-ALL — FINAL REPORT\n")
573	    sys.stdout.write("=" * 74 + "\n")
574	
575	    total = len(rep.checks)
576	    n_pass, n_fail, n_skip = (rep.count(PASS), rep.count(FAIL), rep.count(SKIP))
577	    for ph in ("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"):
578	        p, f, s = (rep.count(PASS, ph), rep.count(FAIL, ph), rep.count(SKIP, ph))
579	        names = {"1": "inventory", "2": "components", "3": "COMPOSITION",
580	                 "4": "MAXIMALITY", "5": "cross-validation"}
581	        sys.stdout.write(
582	            f"  phase {ph} {names[ph]:<18} "
583	            f"{p:>3} pass  {f:>3} fail  {s:>3} skip-silicon\n")
584	    sys.stdout.write("-" * 74 + "\n")
585	    sys.stdout.write(
586	        f"  TOTAL  {n_pass} pass  {n_fail} fail  {n_skip} skip-silicon "
587	        f"(of {total} checks, {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s)\n")
588	
589	    # Maximality / fusion-tier map.
590	    sys.stdout.write("\n  MAXIMALITY — fusion-tier coverage per arch "
591	                     "(higher = more fused):\n")
592	    for arch in ARCHES:
593	        tiers = rep.tier_map.get(arch, {})
594	        parts = [f"{t.split('_')[0]}={tiers[t]}"
595	                 for t in ("L3_FWD_BWD_OPT", "L2_BWD_OPT",
596	                           "L1_OPT_ONLY", "L0_UNFUSED") if tiers.get(t)]
597	        sys.stdout.write(f"    {arch:<9} {'  '.join(parts)}\n")
598	
599	    # The gfx942 decoder/vit L1 demotion is the one tier non-maximality, and it
600	    # is an ESTIMATE pending silicon (the LDS over-count). Surface it precisely.
601	    gfx = rep.tier_map.get("gfx942", {})
602	    if gfx.get("L1_OPT_ONLY"):
603	        sys.stdout.write(
604	            f"    note: {gfx['L1_OPT_ONLY']} gfx942 decoder/vit cells are L1 "
605	            "by the smem ESTIMATE (bwd 66560>65536). Promotion to L3 is\n"
606	            "          silicon-gated (rocprof true-LDS) — see SILICON below.\n")
607	
608	    # Silicon-only items.
609	    sys.stdout.write("\n  SILICON-ONLY (cannot be proven on this host — no "
610	                     "GPU/TPU):\n")
611	    sil = list(dict.fromkeys(rep.silicon))  # dedupe, keep order
612	    sil += [
613	        "Real latency / throughput + autotuner config selection (needs GPU)",
614	        "99-cell numeric parity vs fp64 PyTorch reference (needs GPU/TPU exec)",
615	        "gfx942 decoder/vit L1→L3 promotion via rocprof true-LDS (≤64KB?)",
616	        "ptxas -v / roc-obj SASS emission check (HGMMA/UTMALDG/v_mfma counts)",
617	    ]
618	    for s in sil:
619	        sys.stdout.write(f"    🟡 {s}\n")
620	
621	    # Design choices (only genuine ones).
622	    sys.stdout.write("\n  DESIGN CHOICES still open for you:\n")
623	    if not rep.design:
624	        sys.stdout.write("    (none — all prior D1–D7 decided; nothing new "
625	                         "surfaced by this run)\n")
626	    else:
627	        for d in rep.design:
628	            sys.stdout.write(f"    • {d}\n")
629	
630	    # Verdict.
631	    sys.stdout.write("\n" + "=" * 74 + "\n")
632	    if n_fail == 0:
633	        sys.stdout.write(
634	            "  VERDICT: PASS — every runnable check green. The codebase is\n"
635	            "  composition-complete and MAXIMAL aside from the silicon-only\n"
636	            "  items above (which require a real accelerator to close).\n")
637	    else:
638	        sys.stdout.write(
639	            f"  VERDICT: FAIL — {n_fail} check(s) failed. See FAIL lines "
640	            "above.\n")
641	    sys.stdout.write("=" * 74 + "\n")
642	    return 1 if n_fail else 0
643	
644	
645	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
646	# Driver
647	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
648	
649	def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
650	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
651	        prog="python -m grokking_optimizers.verify_all",
652	        description="End-all-be-all verification: prove the modular "
653	                    "composition compiles AND runs maximally across all 99 "
654	                    "fused pipelines.")
655	    ap.add_argument("--phase", choices=["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"], default=None,
656	                    help="Run only one phase (default: all).")
657	    ap.add_argument("--quick", action="store_true",
658	                    help="Skip the compile-heavy phases 2+3 (inventory + "
659	                         "maximality + cross-val only).")
660	    ap.add_argument("--jobs", "-j", type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4,
661	                    help="Parallel compile workers (default: ncpu).")
662	    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
663	
664	    started = time.monotonic()
665	    tc = probe_toolchain()
666	    sys.stdout.write("[PHASE 0] toolchain probe\n")
667	    sys.stdout.write(
668	        f"  nvcc={'yes' if tc.nvcc else 'NO'}  "
669	        f"clang={'yes' if tc.clang else 'NO'}  "
670	        f"jax={'yes' if tc.has_jax else 'NO'}  "
671	        f"gpu={'yes' if tc.has_gpu else 'NO'}  "
672	        f"tpu={'yes' if tc.has_tpu else 'NO'}  jobs={args.jobs}\n")
673	
674	    rep = Report()
675	    run_all = args.phase is None
676	
677	    if run_all or args.phase == "1":
678	        phase1_inventory(rep)
679	    if (run_all and not args.quick) or args.phase == "2":
680	        phase2_components(rep, tc, args.jobs)
681	    if (run_all and not args.quick) or args.phase == "3":
682	        phase3_composition(rep, tc, args.jobs)
683	    if run_all or args.phase == "4":
684	        phase4_maximality(rep)
685	    if run_all or args.phase == "5":
686	        phase5_crossval(rep, tc)
687	
688	    # Always need the tier map for the report; fill it if phase 4 was skipped.
689	    if not rep.tier_map:
690	        for p in mk.solve_all():
691	            rep.tier_map.setdefault(p.arch, {})
692	            rep.tier_map[p.arch][p.tier.name] = \
693	                rep.tier_map[p.arch].get(p.tier.name, 0) + 1
694	
695	    return phase6_report(rep, tc, started)
696	
697	
698	if __name__ == "__main__":
699	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""Autotuner → product-build linkage: per-TU tuned-flag injection.
2	
3	This module is the single source of truth for lever (b): making the
4	``compile.py`` autotuner's winning launch parameters ACTIVE in the shipped
5	``grokking_optimizers/_ops*.so`` instead of decorative.
6	
7	Producer  : ``grokking_optimizers.compile.build_jit`` calls
8	            :func:`export_winner` the moment a JIT winner is decided,
9	            persisting per-(arch, model, optimizer) winners to the canonical
10	            JSON at ``grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json``.
11	Consumer  : ``setup.py``'s ``BuildExtension`` subclass reads that JSON and,
12	            per CUDA translation unit, appends ``-DSG_TUNED_*`` macros (and
13	            ``--maxrregcount`` when nonzero) to the nvcc flags of the TUs
14	            that belong to the matching optimizer — see
15	            :func:`source_extra_nvcc_flags` and :func:`compute_source_flags`.
16	
17	SCHEMA (#12) — the JSON is keyed ``{arch: {model: {optimizer: combo}}}`` (the
18	canonical short ``model`` token), so tuning the same optimizer on two models no
19	longer last-wins; each ``mega_<model>_<opt>.cu`` cell gets ITS model's winner
20	(:func:`model_for_source`), shared ``launch_<opt>.cu`` launchers fall back to a
21	deterministic model's winner. The OLD flat ``{arch: {optimizer: combo}}`` shape
22	is still READ (backward-compat, :func:`_lookup_combo`) and MIGRATED in place on
23	the next :func:`export_winner` write, so a pre-#12 JSON keeps working.
24	
25	IMPORT DISCIPLINE — this module is *pure stdlib* and MUST stay that way.
26	It is loaded by ``setup.py`` (which already imports torch, but should not
27	re-import the heavy package) and by ``tuning/test_build_injection.py``
28	(CPU-only, no torch / no GPU). Both load it by FILE PATH so that importing
29	it never triggers ``grokking_optimizers/__init__.py`` (which does
30	``import torch`` + ``get_ops()`` and would probe CUDA). Do NOT add any
31	``grokking_optimizers``-relative imports or third-party imports here.
32	
33	SCOPE — the SAFE per-TU floor (the megakernel / L3-TC launch dims the
34	committed sm_90 kernels actually read via ``#ifndef SG_TUNED_*`` — mega_block,
35	tile_m/tile_n, the per-model dW split-K factors, and the warp-group register
36	caps prod_regs/cons_regs — as ``-DSG_TUNED_*`` macros + maxrregcount as a real
37	``--maxrregcount=N`` ptxas flag) is hardcoded in :data:`MACROS` as the
38	always-known floor. Review fix P0.2: the exporter ALSO persists EVERY OTHER
39	winner dim that carries a macro in the live search space, together with the
40	dim→macro map the producer derived. The consumer
41	(:func:`source_extra_nvcc_flags`) reads that persisted ``_macros`` map so it can
42	emit ``-D<macro>=<v>`` for dims it has no hardcoded entry for — WITHOUT
43	importing compile.py (this module stays pure stdlib). Tuple dims (cluster_shape)
44	emit nvcc-safe per-axis scalar macros ``<MACRO>_0/_1/_2`` plus
45	``<MACRO>_VOLUME`` exactly as compile.py's ``resolve_macros`` does (a single
46	``-Dfoo=2,1,1`` is rejected by the -D lexer). An unknown macro (no map entry,
47	not in MACROS) is IGNORED with a one-line warning so a stale setup.py degrades
48	gracefully (task P0.2).
49	
50	LIVE-MACRO AUDIT (2026-06 re-derivation) — the previous :data:`MACROS` table
51	listed SG_TUNED_BLOCK_SIZE / VEC_WIDTH / UNROLL / ASYNC_DEPTH, which were the
52	guards in the DELETED eager per-op headers ``grokking_optimizers/kernels/sm_90/
53	*_sm90.cuh``. A grep of the committed device tree
54	(``grep -rnE 'SG_TUNED_[A-Z0-9_]+' csrc``) shows NO current kernel ``#ifndef``s
55	or reads any of those four — so every tuned build emitted four dead ``-D``
56	flags while the macros the kernels DO read got nothing. The macros with a live
57	``#ifndef`` guard AND a matching autotuner tuning dim (compile.py ``_dim(...)``
58	with a ``macro=``) are exactly the floor below; their in-source ``#ifndef``
59	defaults are recorded so a no-JSON build is byte-identical and the drift guard
60	(:func:`header_default_macros`) can flag future divergence.
61	"""
62	
63	from __future__ import annotations
64	
65	import json
66	import os
67	import tempfile
68	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
69	
70	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
71	# Canonical paths.
72	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
73	# This file lives at grokking_optimizers/_tuned_inject.py; the JSON sits next
74	# to it at grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json, and the repo root is the
75	# parent of the grokking_optimizers package directory.
76	_PKG_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
77	REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(_PKG_DIR)
78	KERNEL_TUNED_JSON = os.path.join(_PKG_DIR, "_kernel_tuned.json")
79	
80	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
81	# Arch-key canonicalization.
82	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
83	# compile.py's ARCH_TABLE maps the user-facing "sm_90" to the internal
84	# "sm_90a" (the architecture-specific Hopper target). The JSON and every
85	# consumer here use the SHORT, user-facing key ("sm_90") so the exporter and
86	# the setup.py reader agree on one string. canonical_arch_key() folds the
87	# "a"/"f" suffix variants back to the short form.
88	def canonical_arch_key(arch: str) -> str:
89	    """Fold an internal arch string (e.g. ``"sm_90a"``) to its short JSON key.
90	
91	    ``"sm_90a" -> "sm_90"``, ``"sm_120f" -> "sm_120"``, ``"gfx942" -> "gfx942"``,
92	    ``"sm_90" -> "sm_90"``. Unknown strings pass through unchanged.
93	    """
94	    a = str(arch).strip()
95	    if a.startswith("sm_"):
96	        # strip a trailing single arch-letter suffix ("a"/"f") if present.
97	        if a and a[-1].isalpha() and a[:-1].rsplit("_", 1)[-1].isdigit():
98	            return a[:-1]
99	    return a
100	
101	
102	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
103	# SOURCE OF TRUTH — the SAFE per-TU floor (LIVE sm_90 macros only).
104	#
105	# Each entry maps a winner-combo key (the search-space dim NAME used by
106	# compile.py's ``_dim(...)``, e.g. "mega_block") to how it is emitted on the
107	# compiler command line. There are two kinds:
108	#   kind="macro": emitted as ``-D<macro>=<value>`` (an nvcc preprocessor
109	#                 define). The macro name MUST match the ``#ifndef`` guard
110	#                 in a committed kernel so the override actually takes.
111	#   kind="flag": emitted as a real ptxas/codegen flag, NOT a -D macro.
112	#                ``maxrregcount`` -> ``--maxrregcount=<n>`` (CUDA). A value
113	#                of 0 means "unset" and emits NOTHING (the historical
114	#                default — nvcc's own register allocator decides).
115	#
116	# Every macro dim here is BOTH (a) read by a committed sm_90 kernel via a live
117	# ``#ifndef SG_TUNED_*`` guard AND (b) produced by an autotuner tuning dim
118	# (compile.py ``_dim(name, ..., macro=...)``), so a winner combo can actually
119	# carry it. dim name → macro → consumer file:line → in-source #ifndef default:
120	#   mega_block      SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK     csrc/fused/megakernel_common.cuh:50  256
121	#                     (also opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh:1262; launch_bounds of every
122	#                      sm_90 fused megakernel — decoder/vit/mamba/SG2)
123	#   tile_m          SG_TUNED_TILE_M         csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/wgmma.cuh:136 128
124	#                     (also model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:75 =128 / _mamba_tc.cuh:78 =64)
125	#   tile_n          SG_TUNED_TILE_N         csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/wgmma.cuh:133 128
126	#                     (shared by decoder/vit/mamba TC substrates)
127	#   dec_dw_splitk   SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_SPLITK  csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:101 1
128	#   vit_dw_splitk   SG_TUNED_VIT_DW_SPLITK  csrc/fused/sm_90/model_stage_vit_tc.cuh:105 4
129	#   (mb_dw_splitk REMOVED 2026-06-17: the Mamba-3 TC rewrite dropped the
130	#    output-stationary dW split-K machinery — mb_dw_part_floats()==0 — so
131	#    SG_TUNED_MB_DW_SPLITK is no longer #defined/consumed by any kernel.)
132	#   prod_regs       SG_TUNED_PROD_REGS      csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/tile_pipeline.cuh:92 40
133	#   cons_regs       SG_TUNED_CONS_REGS      csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/tile_pipeline.cuh:95 232
134	#   maxrregcount    (ptxas flag)            --maxrregcount=N (no -D macro)          0 (unset)
135	#
136	# ``default`` records the in-source #ifndef default for the macro dims (the
137	# wgmma.cuh substrate value where a macro is multiply-#ifndef'd — that header
138	# is included first, so its default wins), so a CPU-only unit test can assert
139	# "no drift" between this table and the headers without a GPU, AND so a no-JSON
140	# build is byte-identical (no -D emitted at all when there is no winner).
141	#
142	# NB: SG_TUNED_BLOCK_SIZE / VEC_WIDTH / UNROLL / ASYNC_DEPTH were the guards in
143	# the DELETED eager headers (grokking_optimizers/kernels/sm_90/*_sm90.cuh); NO
144	# committed kernel reads them, so they were dropped from this floor (they only
145	# emitted dead -D flags). SG_TUNED_MIN_BLOCKS / CLUSTER_SHAPE are likewise NOT
146	# guarded by any committed kernel (only mentioned in a comment), so they are
147	# not in the floor either; the GEMM-stage / interleave / pipe-depth / gemm-impl
148	# macros ARE #ifndef'd but have no autotuner tuning dim, so no winner carries
149	# them.
150	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
151	MACROS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
152	    "mega_block":    {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK",    "default": 256},
153	    "tile_m":        {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_TILE_M",        "default": 128},
154	    "tile_n":        {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_TILE_N",        "default": 128},
155	    "dec_dw_splitk": {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_SPLITK", "default": 1},
156	    "vit_dw_splitk": {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_VIT_DW_SPLITK", "default": 4},
157	    "prod_regs":     {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_PROD_REGS",     "default": 40},
158	    "cons_regs":     {"kind": "macro", "macro": "SG_TUNED_CONS_REGS",     "default": 232},
159	    # Real ptxas flag (no preprocessor macro). 0 == unset == emit nothing.
160	    "maxrregcount":  {"kind": "flag", "flag": "--maxrregcount", "default": 0},
161	}
162	
163	# Order in which to emit flags for a TU (stable output → deterministic
164	# build.ninja diffs and a predictable unit-test expectation).
165	_EMIT_ORDER = ["mega_block", "tile_m", "tile_n",
166	               "dec_dw_splitk", "vit_dw_splitk",
167	               "prod_regs", "cons_regs", "maxrregcount"]
168	
169	# The canonical optimizer tokens (mirrors
170	# grokking_optimizers.dispatch.OPTIMIZERS). Used to validate filename→opt
171	# parses. Kept as a literal so this stdlib-only module never imports the
172	# heavier dispatch module (which pulls torch).
173	OPTIMIZERS: Tuple[str, ...] = (
174	    "adamw", "grokadamw", "grokfast", "lion", "looksam", "muon",
175	    "neuralgrok", "prodigy", "supergrok11", "supergrok15", "supergrok2",
176	)
177	
178	# #12 per-model schema — short model keys used in the nested JSON, and the
179	# filename-token → short-key map for the megakernel cell TUs. The cell TUs are
180	# named mega_<model>_<opt>.cu where <model> is the CANONICAL token
181	# (transformer_decoder / mamba3 / vit); the JSON keys are the SHORT names
182	# (decoder / mamba / vit) the CLI + dispatch.short_model_name use. Kept as a
183	# literal so this stdlib-only module never imports dispatch.
184	MODELS: Tuple[str, ...] = ("decoder", "vit", "mamba")
185	_MODEL_TOKEN_TO_SHORT: Dict[str, str] = {
186	    "decoder": "decoder", "transformer_decoder": "decoder",
187	    "vit": "vit",
188	    "mamba": "mamba", "mamba3": "mamba",
189	}
190	
191	
192	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
193	# Drift guard (design item 1c): verify the MACROS table against the kernel
194	# header's #ifndef defaults. CPU-only, grep-free at build time — the table
195	# carries its own expected defaults and a unit test (and an optional
196	# best-effort build-time check) compares them to the committed header.
197	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
198	def header_default_macros() -> Dict[str, int]:
199	    """The macro→default mapping this module asserts the committed kernels ship.
200	
201	    A drift between this and the actual ``#ifndef`` guard in the committed
202	    device tree (csrc/) would mean we emit a ``-D`` for a macro no kernel reads
203	    (silent no-op) or miss one a kernel added. setup.py's
204	    :func:`_verify_macro_names` scans csrc/ for ``#ifndef SG_TUNED_*`` and warns
205	    on any macro here that no kernel guards (drift detection, non-fatal).
206	    """
207	    return {spec["macro"]: spec["default"]
208	            for spec in MACROS.values() if spec["kind"] == "macro"}

211	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
212	# TU → optimizer mapping (the ambiguous-TU policy).
213	#
214	# A CUDA TU gets per-optimizer tuned flags ONLY when its filename encodes an
215	# optimizer by the repo's naming convention:
216	#   * per-optimizer launcher:  csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/launch_<opt>.cu
217	#       (the matching kernels/sm_90/<opt>_sm90.cuh is HEADER-INCLUDED by this
218	#        TU, so the macros applied here reach the kernel body)
219	#   * megakernel cell:         csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_<model>_<opt>.cu
220	#
221	# EVERYTHING ELSE gets NO per-opt flags (returns None):
222	#   * bindings (bindings.cpp, dispatch.cpp) — not even CUDA
223	#   * model-only TUs (models/<model>.cu, mma.cuh, primitives.cuh, ...)
224	#   * common/utils TUs
225	# This is the deliberate "ambiguous TU ⇒ defaults" behavior: a TU that does
226	# not name exactly one optimizer keeps the in-header defaults.
227	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
228	def optimizer_for_source(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
229	    """Return the optimizer a CUDA TU belongs to, or ``None`` if ambiguous.
230	
231	    Matches ``launch_<opt>.cu`` and ``mega_<model>_<opt>.cu`` by basename;
232	    the ``<opt>`` token must be one of :data:`OPTIMIZERS`. Greedy on the
233	    optimizer suffix so ``mega_transformer_decoder_supergrok2.cu`` resolves
234	    to ``supergrok2`` (not a shorter prefix). Non-``.cu`` paths and any TU
235	    that does not encode exactly one known optimizer return ``None``.
236	    """
237	    base = os.path.basename(str(path))
238	    # Only CUDA TUs carry nvcc flags. (.cpp bindings, .py launchers: never.)
239	    if not base.endswith(".cu"):
240	        return None
241	    stem = base[:-len(".cu")]
242	
243	    if stem.startswith("launch_"):
244	        cand = stem[len("launch_"):]
245	        return cand if cand in OPTIMIZERS else None
246	
247	    if stem.startswith("mega_"):
248	        # mega_<model>_<opt>: the optimizer is the LAST underscore-group that
249	        # forms a known optimizer token. Test the longest known-opt suffix.
250	        rest = stem[len("mega_"):]
251	        for opt in sorted(OPTIMIZERS, key=len, reverse=True):
252	            if rest == opt or rest.endswith("_" + opt):
253	                return opt
254	        return None
255	
256	    # models/<model>.cu, primitives.cuh, mma.cuh, etc. — no single optimizer.
257	    return None
258	
259	
260	def model_for_source(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
261	    """Return the SHORT model token a megakernel-cell TU belongs to, or ``None``.
262	
263	    #12 per-model schema: the INJECTED cells are named ``mega_<model>_<opt>.cu``
264	    where ``<model>`` is the canonical token (``transformer_decoder`` /
265	    ``mamba3`` / ``vit``); this returns the SHORT key (``decoder`` / ``mamba`` /
266	    ``vit``) used in the nested JSON so the consumer can select that cell's
267	    per-model winner. Returns ``None`` for a per-optimizer LAUNCHER TU
268	    (``launch_<opt>.cu`` is shared across models — it has no single model) and
269	    for any TU that does not encode exactly one known optimizer — including the
270	    standalone real-TC cells ``mega_<model>_real_adamw_tc.cu`` (whose suffix is
271	    ``_real_adamw_tc``, not a bare optimizer, so :func:`optimizer_for_source`
272	    already returns ``None``; those are NOT ninja-injection targets — they get
273	    their tuned tile macros from compile.py's real-TC-step timer build, not from
274	    the per-TU ninja pass). The ``<model>`` is the prefix between ``mega_`` and
275	    the trailing ``_<opt>`` token, matched longest-first against the known model
276	    tokens so ``transformer_decoder`` wins over a shorter prefix."""
277	    base = os.path.basename(str(path))
278	    if not base.endswith(".cu"):
279	        return None
280	    stem = base[:-len(".cu")]
281	    if not stem.startswith("mega_"):
282	        return None
283	    opt = optimizer_for_source(path)
284	    if opt is None:
285	        return None
286	    rest = stem[len("mega_"):]
287	    # strip the trailing optimizer token to leave the model token(s).
288	    if rest.endswith("_" + opt):
289	        model_tok = rest[: -(len("_" + opt))]
290	    else:  # rest == opt (no model component) — shouldn't reach here for a cell.
291	        return None
292	    for known in sorted(_MODEL_TOKEN_TO_SHORT, key=len, reverse=True):
293	        if model_tok == known or model_tok.startswith(known + "_"):
294	            return _MODEL_TOKEN_TO_SHORT[known]
295	    return None
296

298	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
299	# Flag computation.
300	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
301	# Warn at most once per (arch, dim) about an unmapped macro dim, so a stale
302	# setup.py degrades gracefully (P0.2) without spamming the build log.
303	_WARNED_UNMAPPED: set = set()
304	
305	# Arch-level bookkeeping keys that live alongside the model/optimizer sub-blocks
306	# and must NOT be mistaken for a model name during shape detection.
307	_ARCH_RESERVED_KEYS = frozenset({"_macros", "_meta"})
308	
309	
310	def _arch_block_is_nested(arch_block: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
311	    """#12 — distinguish the NEW per-model nested shape
312	    ``{model: {optimizer: combo}}`` from the OLD flat shape
313	    ``{optimizer: combo}`` for ONE arch block.
314	
315	    Nested iff some non-reserved key maps to a dict that itself contains at
316	    least one known-OPTIMIZER key whose value is a dict (a model→opt→combo
317	    nesting). The old flat shape keys directly by optimizer, whose combo dict's
318	    values are scalars/lists (never an optimizer→dict nesting), so it returns
319	    False. An empty / malformed block is treated as flat (the safe default —
320	    the flat reader simply finds nothing)."""
321	    for k, v in arch_block.items():
322	        if k in _ARCH_RESERVED_KEYS:
323	            continue
324	        if isinstance(v, dict) and any(
325	                opt in v and isinstance(v[opt], dict) for opt in OPTIMIZERS):
326	            return True
327	    return False
328	
329	
330	def _lookup_combo(arch_block: Dict[str, Any], optimizer: str,
331	                  model: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
332	    """Resolve the winner combo for ``optimizer`` under ``arch_block``, reading
333	    BOTH the new per-model nested shape and the old flat shape (#12).
334	
335	    * NEW nested ``{model: {optimizer: combo}}``:
336	        - ``model`` given  → ``arch_block[model][optimizer]``.
337	        - ``model`` None   → first model sub-block (deterministic: the JSON's
338	          sorted model keys) that records this optimizer. This is the
339	          shared-launcher-TU case (``launch_<opt>.cu`` spans all models): it
340	          keeps the historical "one winner applies to every TU of this opt"
341	          semantics, now picking a stable model's winner.
342	    * OLD flat ``{optimizer: combo}``: ``arch_block[optimizer]`` (``model`` is
343	      ignored — the old schema had no model dimension).
344	
345	    Returns the combo dict or ``None`` (absent / wrong shape)."""
346	    if _arch_block_is_nested(arch_block):
347	        if model is not None:
348	            sub = arch_block.get(model)
349	            if isinstance(sub, dict):
350	                combo = sub.get(optimizer)
351	                return combo if isinstance(combo, dict) else None
352	            return None
353	        # No model context (shared launcher TU): pick a deterministic model
354	        # sub-block that has this optimizer.
355	        for mkey in sorted(k for k in arch_block
356	                           if k not in _ARCH_RESERVED_KEYS):
357	            sub = arch_block.get(mkey)
358	            if isinstance(sub, dict) and isinstance(sub.get(optimizer), dict):
359	                return sub[optimizer]
360	        return None
361	    # Old flat shape.
362	    combo = arch_block.get(optimizer)
363	    return combo if isinstance(combo, dict) else None
364	
365	
366	def source_extra_nvcc_flags(optimizer: Optional[str],
367	                            tuned: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
368	                            arch_key: str,
369	                            model: Optional[str] = None) -> List[str]:
370	    """Extra nvcc flags for ONE optimizer's TUs under ``arch_key``.
371	
372	    Returns ``[]`` when there is nothing tuned for this (arch, optimizer)
373	    — i.e. when ``optimizer is None`` (ambiguous TU), ``tuned`` is empty/None
374	    (no JSON), the arch is absent, or the optimizer has no recorded winner.
375	    Same value is applied to every TU of the same optimizer (design 1b).
376	
377	    #12 — ``model`` (the SHORT model token for a ``mega_<model>_<opt>.cu`` cell,
378	    via :func:`model_for_source`) selects that cell's per-model winner from the
379	    NEW nested ``{arch: {model: {optimizer: ...}}}`` schema. ``None`` (a shared
380	    ``launch_<opt>.cu`` launcher, or any caller that doesn't know the model)
381	    falls back to a deterministic model's winner. The OLD flat
382	    ``{arch: {optimizer: ...}}`` schema is still read (``model`` ignored) so a
383	    pre-#12 JSON keeps working unchanged. See :func:`_lookup_combo`.
384	
385	    Deterministic order: the hardcoded SAFE floor dims first (``_EMIT_ORDER``),
386	    then any EXTRA persisted macro dims (P0.2) in sorted order. Scalar macro
387	    dims become ``-D<macro>=<v>``; tuple dims (cluster_shape) become per-axis
388	    ``-D<macro>_0/_1/_2`` + ``-D<macro>_VOLUME`` (nvcc rejects ``-Dfoo=2,1,1``);
389	    ``maxrregcount`` becomes ``--maxrregcount=<n>`` only when ``n > 0``. The
390	    extra dims' macro names come from the persisted ``_macros`` map; an
391	    UNKNOWN dim (not SAFE and not in the map) is ignored with a one-line
392	    warning (graceful degradation for a stale reader).
393	    """
394	    if optimizer is None or not tuned:
395	        return []
396	    canon = canonical_arch_key(arch_key)
397	    arch_block = tuned.get(canon)
398	    if not isinstance(arch_block, dict):
399	        return []
400	    combo = _lookup_combo(arch_block, optimizer, model)
401	    if not isinstance(combo, dict):
402	        return []
403	    # P0.2 — producer-persisted dim→macro map for the extra (non-SAFE) dims.
404	    macro_map = arch_block.get("_macros")
405	    if not isinstance(macro_map, dict):
406	        macro_map = {}
407	
408	    flags: List[str] = []
409	    # (1) hardcoded SAFE floor, in canonical emit order.
410	    for key in _EMIT_ORDER:
411	        if key not in combo:
412	            continue
413	        spec = MACROS.get(key)
414	        if spec is None:
415	            continue
416	        value = combo[key]
417	        if spec["kind"] == "macro":
418	            flags.append(f"-D{spec['macro']}={_macro_value(value)}")
419	        elif spec["kind"] == "flag":
420	            # maxrregcount: 0/None/unset => emit nothing (nvcc default alloc).
421	            try:
422	                n = int(value)
423	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
424	                continue
425	            if n > 0:
426	                flags.append(f"{spec['flag']}={n}")
427	    # (2) extra persisted macro dims (cluster_shape + any consumed feature
428	    # macro), sorted for deterministic build.ninja output. Skip the SAFE dims
429	    # (already emitted), the model provenance, and any internal bookkeeping.
430	    for key in sorted(combo.keys()):
431	        if key in MACROS or key in _NON_DIM_KEYS:
432	            continue
433	        value = combo[key]
434	        macro = macro_map.get(key)
435	        if not macro:
436	            # Unknown dim with no mapping — a stale setup.py can't know its
437	            # macro name. Ignore it (graceful degradation) but say so once.
438	            wk = (canon, key)
439	            if wk not in _WARNED_UNMAPPED:
440	                _WARNED_UNMAPPED.add(wk)
441	                import sys as _sys
442	                _sys.stderr.write(
443	                    f"  [tuned-inject] WARNING: winner dim {key!r} for "
444	                    f"{optimizer}/{canon} has no macro mapping in the JSON's "
445	                    f"_macros table; skipping it (the kernel keeps its in-header "
446	                    f"default). Re-export with a current compile.py to map it.\n")
447	            continue
448	        flags.extend(_emit_macro_flags(macro, value))
449	    return flags
450	
451	
452	def _emit_macro_flags(macro: str, value: Any) -> List[str]:
453	    """Emit nvcc-safe ``-D`` flags for one macro dim's value.
454	
455	    Mirrors compile.py's ``resolve_macros``: a tuple/list value (cluster_shape)
456	    becomes per-axis ``-D<macro>_0/_1/_2`` plus ``-D<macro>_VOLUME=<product>``
457	    (a single ``-Dfoo=2,1,1`` is rejected by the -D lexer); a scalar becomes
458	    ``-D<macro>=<v>``."""
459	    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
460	        out: List[str] = []
461	        comps = list(value)
462	        for i, comp in enumerate(comps):
463	            out.append(f"-D{macro}_{i}={_macro_value(comp)}")
464	        vol = 1
465	        for comp in comps:
466	            try:
467	                vol *= int(comp)
468	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
469	                vol = 0
470	                break
471	        out.append(f"-D{macro}_VOLUME={vol}")
472	        return out
473	    return [f"-D{macro}={_macro_value(value)}"]
474	
475	
476	def _macro_value(value: Any) -> str:
477	    if isinstance(value, bool):
478	        return "1" if value else "0"
479	    return str(value)
480	
481	
482	def compute_source_flags(sources: List[str],
483	                         tuned: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
484	                         arch_key: str) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
485	    """Map each source path to its extra nvcc flag list (only nonempty ones).
486	
487	    The product of the whole module: feed it the extension's ``sources`` and
488	    the loaded JSON; it returns ``{abspath_or_path: [flags...]}`` for exactly
489	    the TUs that resolve to a tuned optimizer. Sources with no per-opt flags
490	    are OMITTED from the dict (callers treat "absent" as "stock flags").
491	    Keys preserve the input path string (callers match against the same
492	    ``sources`` they passed). A per-(optimizer, model) flag list is computed
493	    once and shared across TUs with the same (optimizer, model).
494	
495	    #12 — each ``mega_<model>_<opt>.cu`` cell is keyed by its OWN model
496	    (:func:`model_for_source`) so it picks up THAT model's per-model winner from
497	    the nested schema; shared ``launch_<opt>.cu`` launchers carry ``model=None``
498	    and get a deterministic model's winner. Under the OLD flat schema the model
499	    is ignored, so behaviour is identical to before.
500	    """
501	    out: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
502	    cache: Dict[Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]], List[str]] = {}
503	    for src in sources:
504	        opt = optimizer_for_source(src)
505	        if opt is None:
506	            continue
507	        model = model_for_source(src)   # None for shared launcher TUs
508	        ck = (opt, model)
509	        if ck not in cache:
510	            cache[ck] = source_extra_nvcc_flags(opt, tuned, arch_key, model)
511	        flags = cache[ck]
512	        if flags:
513	            out[src] = list(flags)
514	    return out

520	def load_tuned(path: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
521	    """Load the canonical tuned JSON. ``None`` if absent or unreadable.
522	
523	    A missing / malformed JSON is NOT an error — it means "no winners yet",
524	    and the build proceeds with in-header defaults (graceful degradation,
525	    design 1b). The caller logs a one-line notice in that case.
526	    """
527	    p = path or KERNEL_TUNED_JSON
528	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
529	        return None
530	    try:
531	        with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
532	            data = json.load(fh)
533	    except (OSError, ValueError):
534	        return None
535	    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None

538	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
539	# JSON export (producer side — compile.py build_jit).
540	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
541	# The SAFE per-TU floor dims are ALWAYS persisted (the MACROS floor). Review fix
542	# P0.2: EVERY other winner dim that carries a macro in the live search space is
543	# persisted too (so a winning cluster_shape / feature-macro value actually
544	# reaches the product build instead of being silently dropped). Bookkeeping keys
545	# (timing_ms, config_key, stage_won, fast-math markers, ...) are still dropped —
546	# the JSON is a STABLE handoff contract, not a dump of the trial record.
547	_PERSIST_KEYS = tuple(MACROS.keys())  # mega_block, tile_m/n, *_dw_splitk,
548	                                      # prod_regs, cons_regs, maxrregcount
549	
550	# Combo keys that are autotuner bookkeeping, never a tunable macro dim — always
551	# dropped from the persisted payload regardless of the macro map.
552	_NON_DIM_KEYS = frozenset({
553	    "timing_ms", "config_key", "stage_won", "_fastmath", "origin", "status",
554	    "error", "value_ms", "trial_num", "stage", "host", "model",
555	})
556	
557	
558	def _coerce_scalar(value: Any) -> Optional[Any]:
559	    """Coerce a winner value to a JSON-stable scalar, or None to skip."""
560	    if isinstance(value, bool):
561	        return bool(value)
562	    if isinstance(value, (int, float, str)):
563	        return value
564	    return None
565	
566	
567	def _winner_payload(combo: Dict[str, Any],
568	                    macro_map: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
569	                    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
570	    """Project a winner combo down to the persisted dims.
571	
572	    P0.2: persists (a) the hardcoded SAFE floor dims (always), and (b) EVERY
573	    extra combo key present in ``macro_map`` (the producer-derived dim→macro
574	    map from the live search space). Scalars persist as-is; tuple/list dims
575	    (cluster_shape) persist as a list so the consumer can emit per-axis macros.
576	    Keys that are neither a SAFE dim nor in the macro map are dropped (they are
577	    bookkeeping or non-macro flags)."""
578	    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {}
579	    # (a) hardcoded SAFE floor.
580	    for key in _PERSIST_KEYS:
581	        if key not in combo:
582	            continue
583	        value = combo[key]
584	        if MACROS[key]["kind"] == "flag":
585	            try:
586	                payload[key] = int(value)  # maxrregcount (0 == unset)
587	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
588	                continue
589	        else:
590	            sv = _coerce_scalar(value)
591	            if sv is not None:
592	                payload[key] = sv
593	    # (b) every extra macro-carrying dim the producer derived from the space.
594	    for key, _macro in (macro_map or {}).items():
595	        if key in payload or key in _NON_DIM_KEYS or key not in combo:
596	            continue
597	        value = combo[key]
598	        if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
599	            # Persist tuple dims (e.g. cluster_shape) as a list of ints/scalars;
600	            # the consumer emits FOO_0/_1/_2 + FOO_VOLUME (nvcc-safe).
601	            payload[key] = [_coerce_scalar(v) for v in value
602	                            if _coerce_scalar(v) is not None]
603	        else:
604	            sv = _coerce_scalar(value)
605	            if sv is not None:
606	                payload[key] = sv
607	    return payload
608	
609	
610	def export_winner(optimizer: str,
611	                 model: str,
612	                 arch: str,
613	                 combo: Dict[str, Any],
614	                 *,
615	                 path: Optional[str] = None,
616	                 source: str = "compile.build_jit",
617	                 version_hash: Optional[str] = None,
618	                 macro_map: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> bool:
619	    """Persist ONE (arch, model, optimizer) winner to the canonical JSON.
620	
621	    READ-MERGE-WRITE (design 1a): ``build_jit`` runs a single (model,
622	    optimizer), so this merges into any existing JSON rather than overwriting —
623	    tuning every (model, optimizer) in sequence accumulates one entry each. The
624	    write is atomic (tmp file + ``os.replace``) so a reader never sees a
625	    half-written file.
626	
627	    #12 PER-MODEL SCHEMA: the winner is keyed by ``{arch: {model: {optimizer:
628	    combo}}}`` (the canonical short ``model`` token), so tuning the same
629	    optimizer on a SECOND model NO LONGER clobbers the first — each (model,
630	    optimizer) is its own slot. An existing OLD-flat arch block
631	    (``{optimizer: combo}``, pre-#12) is MIGRATED in place on the first write:
632	    each flat ``optimizer`` entry is moved under its recorded ``model``
633	    provenance (defaulting to this call's ``model`` if absent), then the new
634	    winner is merged into the nested tree. The consumer reads both shapes
635	    (:func:`_lookup_combo`), so a half-migrated or still-flat JSON stays valid.
636	
637	    ``macro_map`` (P0.2) is the producer-derived ``{dim_name: SG_TUNED_MACRO}``
638	    map for THIS arch's live search space. The extra (non-SAFE) dims it names
639	    are persisted in the winner, and the map itself is recorded in the arch
640	    block under ``_macros`` so the stdlib-only consumer
641	    (:func:`source_extra_nvcc_flags`) can emit ``-D<macro>=<v>`` for them
642	    WITHOUT importing compile.py. When ``None`` (legacy callers), behaviour is
643	    the SAFE-floor-only export (the hardcoded MACROS dims).
644	
645	    Returns ``True`` on success, ``False`` on any failure. This function
646	    MUST NEVER raise into the caller — a failed persist is a loud warning,
647	    never a failed tuning run (design 1a). The caller is responsible for the
648	    warning text; this returns False and leaves the existing JSON intact.
649	
650	    NOTE on concurrency: atomic rename makes each write self-consistent, but
651	    naive read-merge-write loses entries if multiple per-optimizer PROCESSES
652	    race. The runbook directs operators to tune optimizers SEQUENTIALLY (or
653	    funnel winners through one process); see AUTOTUNE_LINKAGE.md.
654	    """
655	    try:
656	        target = path or KERNEL_TUNED_JSON
657	        arch_key = canonical_arch_key(arch)
658	        payload = _winner_payload(combo, macro_map)
659	
660	        # Read-merge: start from any existing JSON so sibling (model, optimizer)
661	        # winners survive. A corrupt existing file is discarded (we cannot
662	        # safely merge into garbage) but reported via the return value path.
663	        existing = load_tuned(target) or {}
664	        if not isinstance(existing, dict):
665	            existing = {}
666	        arch_block = existing.get(arch_key)
667	        if not isinstance(arch_block, dict):
668	            arch_block = {}
669	        # #12 — migrate an old-flat arch block ({optimizer: combo}) to the
670	        # nested per-model shape ({model: {optimizer: combo}}) before merging, so
671	        # a pre-#12 JSON is upgraded in place instead of mixing shapes. Reserved
672	        # keys (_macros) are left at the arch level.
673	        if not _arch_block_is_nested(arch_block):
674	            migrated: Dict[str, Any] = {}
675	            for k in list(arch_block.keys()):
676	                if k in _ARCH_RESERVED_KEYS:
677	                    migrated[k] = arch_block[k]
678	                    continue
679	                old_entry = arch_block[k]
680	                if k in OPTIMIZERS and isinstance(old_entry, dict):
681	                    # provenance model recorded inside the flat entry, else this
682	                    # call's model (best available).
683	                    prov = old_entry.get("model") or model
684	                    migrated.setdefault(prov, {})[k] = old_entry
685	                else:
686	                    # Unknown/foreign key — preserve verbatim so we never drop
687	                    # data we don't understand.
688	                    migrated[k] = old_entry
689	            arch_block = migrated
690	        entry = dict(payload)
691	        entry["model"] = model  # provenance: which model's sweep won this.
692	        model_block = arch_block.get(model)

736	                               dir=directory)

740	            fh.write("\n")
741	        os.replace(tmp, path)
742	    finally:

752	#

754	# testing without running setup()'s torch import + GPU probe. setup.py's
755	# TunedBuildExtension monkeypatches torch's _write_ninja_file to call the
756	# original writer and then :func:`inject_overrides_into_ninja` on the result.
757	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
758	def inject_overrides_into_ninja(ninja_path: str,
759	                                sources: List[str],
760	                                objects: List[str],
761	                                base_cuda_post_cflags: List[str],
762	                                tuned: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
763	                                arch_key: str,
764	                                quote=None) -> int:
765	    """Insert per-build-statement ``cuda_post_cflags`` overrides into a ninja
766	    file for every CUDA TU that maps to a tuned optimizer.
767	
768	    The override line carries the FULL flag list (``base_cuda_post_cflags`` +
769	    that optimizer's tuned extras) so ninja never self-references the variable
770	    (a wrong eval order would silently drop the base arch/-O3/fast-math flags).
771	    Returns the number of build edges that received an override (0 when there
772	    is nothing tuned, no base flags, or no matching CUDA edge).
773	
774	    ``quote`` is an optional callable (``shlex.quote``) applied to each extra
775	    flag so its quoting matches torch's already-quoted ``base`` list; when
776	    None the extras are emitted verbatim (the safe per-TU flags contain no
777	    shell metacharacters).
778	    """
779	    if not base_cuda_post_cflags:
780	        return 0
781	    per_src = compute_source_flags(list(sources), tuned, arch_key)
782	    if not per_src:
783	        return 0
784	    if quote is None:
785	        quote = lambda s: s  # noqa: E731 — identity; safe flags need no quoting.
786	
787	    base = list(base_cuda_post_cflags)
788	    # Map each source's ABSOLUTE object path to its override line. ninja writes
789	    # build edges with os.path.abspath(object), escaping ':' as '$:' and ' '
790	    # as '$ '; we match on the unescaped object path.
791	    overrides: Dict[str, str] = {}
792	    for src, obj in zip(sources, objects):
793	        flags = per_src.get(src)
794	        if not flags:
795	            continue
796	        abs_obj = os.path.abspath(obj)
797	        full = " ".join(base + [quote(f) for f in flags])
798	        overrides[abs_obj] = f"  cuda_post_cflags = {full}"
799	    if not overrides:
800	        return 0
801	
802	    with open(ninja_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
803	        lines = fh.readlines()
804	
805	    out: List[str] = []
806	    injected = 0
807	    for line in lines:
808	        out.append(line)
809	        stripped = line.rstrip("\n")
810	        if stripped.startswith("build ") and "cuda_compile" in stripped:
811	            target = parse_ninja_build_target(stripped)
812	            if target is not None and target in overrides:
813	                out.append(overrides[target] + "\n")
814	                injected += 1
815	    if injected:
816	        with open(ninja_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
817	            fh.writelines(out)
818	    return injected
819	
820	
821	def parse_ninja_build_target(stmt: str) -> Optional[str]:
822	    """Return the (unescaped) object path from a ninja
823	    ``build <obj>: <rule> <ins>`` statement, or ``None``.
824	
825	    ninja escapes ``:`` as ``$:`` and `` `` as ``$ `` inside paths; we walk
826	    the token, treating ``$<c>`` as a literal pair, and stop at the first
827	    UNescaped ``:`` (the rule separator).
828	    """
829	    if not stmt.startswith("build "):
830	        return None
831	    rest = stmt[len("build "):]
832	    i = 0
833	    obj_chars: List[str] = []
834	    found = False
835	    while i < len(rest):
836	        c = rest[i]
837	        if c == "$" and i + 1 < len(rest):
838	            obj_chars.append(rest[i:i + 2])
839	            i += 2
840	            continue
841	        if c == ":":
842	            found = True
843	            break
844	        obj_chars.append(c)
845	        i += 1
846	    if not found:
847	        return None
848	    token = "".join(obj_chars).strip()
849	    return token.replace("$:", ":").replace("$ ", " ")
